news.body: Dylan Sampson ran for seven yards on one carry in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 6-of-8 targets for 62 yards receiving.
news.head: Dylan Sampson catches six passes Sunday
news.impact: Sampson has now caught 9-of-11 targets across two games since returning from injury. He remains on the flex radar in PPR leagues for fantasy managers.

news.body: Dylan Sampson (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) set to play Sunday
news.impact: Sampson is set to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Cleveland's injury report earlier in the week with a knee issue. He isn't expected to see enough work to be fantasy relevant in this matchup, however.

news.body: Dylan Sampson (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Sampson was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a knee issue to start the week on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 8 and will continue to contribute as a depth option behind Quinshon Judkins moving forward.

news.body: Elijah Mitchell rushed the ball three times for six yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Elijah Mitchell totals 23 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He racked up 26 yards on his six touches, and his fantasy total was predictably underwhelming as well. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the time being.

news.body: The Eagles elevated RB Elijah Mitchell for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.head: Elijah Mitchell elevated by Eagles
news.impact: Mitchell will add depth in the backfield for the Eagles.

news.body: Elijah Mitchell carried the ball 11 times for 34 yards and caught four of his six targets for three yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Elijah Mitchell runs for 34 yards in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Mitchell was elevated from the practice squad earlier in the week with the Eagles dealing with multiple injuries to their backfield. He wound up out-snapping Saquon Barkley, although Barkley had two more carries. Mitchell should remain involved in the Philly backfield until Barkley is fully healthy.

news.body: The Eagles elevated RB Elijah Mitchell from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: Elijah Mitchell elevated from practice squad
news.impact: Mitchell will add depth in the backfield for Philadelphia. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed once for 15 yards while catching all five of his targets for 128 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Emmett Johnson explodes for 143 yards, touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Johnson turned a Patrick Mahomes pass into a 73-yard touchdown and finished with 143 total yards on six touches. So, is there a changing of the guard in Kansas City's backfield? No. Kenneth Walker III had 25 touches compared to six for Johnson. That said, 143 yards on six touches should earn Johnson more opportunities moving forward.

news.body: Emmett Johnson caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in a 20-3 loss to Seattle in Week 7.
news.head: Emmett Johnson catches two balls in Week 7
news.impact: Johnson was not given a carry on a sluggish day for the Chiefs on offense. The rookie running back remains an interesting handcuff for fantasy moving forward. He will take on the Broncos in Week 8.

news.body: Emmett Johnson caught his lone target for a 10-yard gain in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Emmett Johnson hauls in 10-yard pass in Week 4
news.impact: Johnson did not record a carry as Kenneth Walker III dominated the backfield work in the win. Johnson will continue to mix in behind Walker as a high-end fantasy handcuff moving forward. He will be on bye in Week 5 before a Week 6 matchup against the Chargers.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed six times for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Emmett Johnson sees six touches in Week 3
news.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 25 rushing yards in each of the first three contests. The running back remains more of a handcuff option for Kenneth Walker owners ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.

news.body: The Commanders placed Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) placed on IR
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt will officially miss the next four weeks. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.

news.body: Jacory Croskey-Merritt has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) ruled out Monday
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt was unable to practice this week. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.

news.body: Jacory Croskey-Merritt was not seen at practice on Friday.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) not at practice Friday
news.impact: It would be the second straight missed practice for Croskey-Merritt. He'll have one more day to practice with the Commanders playing on Monday.

news.body: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially didn't practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially DNP Thursday
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt wasn't seen during the open portion of practice on Friday, and he was indeed sidelined due to a groin issue. It may leave him sidelined in Week 6, although he still has a couple of days to return to practice before the team begins to rule people out.

news.body: Jadarian Price ran for 24 yards on nine carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 54 yards receiving.
news.head: Jadarian Price totals 78 yards from scrimmage Sunday
news.impact: Price led Seattle in receiving on the day, including an impressive 17-yard catch and run. Zach Charbonnet led the Seahawks on the ground on the day. Price should maintain flex value moving forward.

news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
news.impact: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

news.body: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
news.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

news.body: Jadarian Price is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Price will make his return from injured reserve. Zach Charbonnet is also off the injury report, making it the first week all season the Seahawks backfield will be healthy.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 20 times for 74 yards and one touchdown while failing to catch his lone target in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Dolphins
news.impact: Gibbs has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in five of his last six games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 153 yards and one touchdown while also catching two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs shreds tough Vikings defense in Week 8 win
news.impact: Gibbs has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in four of his last five contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs will play on Sunday against the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Gibbs is good to go despite missing practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will remain in his usual role for the Lions and fantasy managers.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs practiced on Thursday.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) practices Thursday
news.impact: Gibbs was not seen during the open portion of practice on Wednesday. His return on Thursday is a good sign for his status for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

news.body: James Cook II rushed for 107 yards and a touchdown on 31 carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: James Cook II goes over 100 yards, finds end zone in Week 9
news.impact: This was a true workhorse effort from Cook. The last time he got 30-plus carries was Week 13 of last season. Cook is one of only three backs in the league currently averaging over 100 rushing yards per game, and Jahmyr Gibbs is the only player carrying the ball more times per game than Cook.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 80 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a five-yard carry in the third quarter. Cook has a rushing touchdown in six straight games. Cook and the Bills have a tough matchup in Week 9 against a strong Vikings' defense.

news.body: James Cook III rushed the ball 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught three passes for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: James Cook III plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cook played great on Sunday. He finished with over 150 total yards and a touchdown against the Raiders, which helped to lead the Bills to a big win on the road. He should continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: James Cook III carried the ball 25 times for 111 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for a seven-yard gain in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: James Cook III rushes for two TDs in Week 5
news.impact: Cook fumbled twice, losing one, on Monday night, but he still managed to post a dominant fantasy outing. The veteran running back rushed for touchdowns of 17 and five yards in the contest. He now has 532 rushing yards and five touchdowns on the season. Cook will be a strong RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 23 yards on five targets in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 9
news.impact: Williams notched his second 100-yard rushing game of the season in the close win over Indy. The veteran running back has been a very reliable fantasy option this season, posting 10 all-purpose touchdowns through nine games. An every-week RB1 in fantasy, Williams will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 24 times for 56 yards while also catching one of his two targets for one yard in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Javonte Williams bottled up in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Williams was held in check out of the backfield, failing to reach the end zone for the first time in his last six contests. The running back will look to get back on track against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: Javonte Williams rushed the ball 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Javonte Williams sets career high in yards Monday
news.impact: Williams was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He set a new career high with 155 rushing yards over the course of the game, and he was also able to get into the end zone towards the end of the game, which was the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with his performance in this primetime matchup.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Williams was held to a season-low 11 carries with the Cowboys falling behind 17-0 at halftime. The veteran still managed to find the end zone, giving him eight all-purpose scores through six games. He will remain a locked-in RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Jaylen Warren runs for 143 yards Sunday
news.impact: Warren did not catch either of his two targets. He tied his career-high in rushing despite Rico Dowdle seeing 15 carries himself. Warren remains a borderline RB1/RB2 heading into the Steelers bye week.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Warren goes off against Saints
news.impact: Warren was the clear lead back for the Steelers on Sunday, showing markedly better efficiency than fellow RB Rico Dowdle. A two-back system will still likely be employed to keep Warren fresh, but Warren is looking like a solid weekly RB1 candidate.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 50 yards on 14 carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 28 yards receiving.
news.head: Jaylen Warren sees 16 touches Sunday
news.impact: Warren was the lead back in the Steelers backfield in the fourth quarter and overtime period over Rico Dowdle. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy labeled Jaylen Warren as the team's featured player when asked about the return of Rico Dowdle.
news.head: Jaylen Warren labeled 'featured player' by Steelers HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: Warren has continued to play very well in the absence of Dowdle. Even when Dowdle makes his return, Warren will remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
news.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is questionable to return for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Love suffered the apparent ankle injury in the second quarter, rushing nine times for 23 yards prior to exiting. Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier will see increased touches out of the Arizona backfield in Love’s absence.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play Sunday

news.body: J.K. Dobbins finished with one reception for four yards as the Broncos defeated the Panthers 26-21 in Week 9.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins struggles again in Week 9
news.impact: Dobbins has lost considerable ground to Jonah Coleman over the last three games. The latter had 21 touches for 88 yards and a touchdown Sunday. Dobbins, meanwhile, hasn't scored since Week 7. The Broncos have shifted their backfield toward Coleman, leaving Dobbins difficult to trust as a fantasy starter.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins held to 13 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed six times for 23 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins Finds End Zone in Week 7
news.impact: Dobbins scored from one yard out late in the third quarter, giving him a touchdown for the third consecutive game. The problem was everything else. His six carries were fewer than both Jonah Coleman's nine and Bo Nix's seven, while RJ Harvey remained involved in the passing game. Dobbins continues to find the end zone, but his workload took a significant hit with Coleman back. The former enters flex territory.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown in Denver's 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday. He also caught three passes for five yards.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins punches in touchdown in win
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't overly efficient in this game, with his long run of 16 yards meaning his other 16 carries went for 25 yards. Still, a touchdown and a few receptions can cover a multitude of sins. He's a volume-based RB3 moving forward.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 17 times for 57 yards and one touchdown while catching four passes for 31 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Jonah Coleman scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Coleman scored from nine yards out in the fourth quarter to give Denver a 19-14 lead. More importantly, he has now led the Broncos in rushing in three straight games since returning from injured reserve. Coleman also caught four passes for the second consecutive week. So, what happened to J.K. Dobbins' role? Coleman has taken over a significant portion of the backfield, including scoring opportunities. The rookie has established himself as Denver's most productive fantasy running back.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 11 times for 41 yards and one touchdown, while catching four of five targets for 63 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jonah Coleman totals 104 yards, scores in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed nine times for 54 yards, while catching both of his targets for 15 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Jonah Coleman Totals 69 Yards in Return
news.impact: Coleman returned from injured reserve and immediately led Denver's running backs with nine carries, averaging six yards per attempt. J.K. Dobbins still received the goal-line touchdown, and RJ Harvey scored through the air, but Coleman's usage in his first game back is difficult to ignore. He's worth rostering as Denver sorts out what could become a three-man backfield. Coleman is worth a start next week for Zero RB drafters.

news.body: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is active for Week 7 for the Denver Broncos against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jonah Coleman (ankle) active for Week 7
news.impact: Coleman will suit up after being activated earlier in the week from injured reserve, providing head coach Sean Payton with another option as part of a backfield including RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins against the Cardinals Sunday.

news.body: The Colts won’t trade RB Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor will not be traded by Colts
news.impact: Pelissero notes that multiple teams offered a second-round pick and more for Taylor, but the Colts wanted more in a deal for him. He'll remain in Indianapolis.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 13 times for 46 yards while catching all five of his targets for 18 yards and losing a fumble in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor loses fumble in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Taylor struggled in what might have been his final game in a Colts uniform with trade rumors swirling around him. The veteran running back has rushed for 656 yards and eight touchdowns through nine games this year. If the Colts don't trade him by Tuesday's trade deadline, he will face the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Taylor was upgraded after he was limited in practice on Wednesday. He is slated to play at least one more game with the Colts before a potential trade happens next week.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor gained 23 yards on eight carries and 24 yards on four receptions in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor does little with a dozen touches in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Taylor opened this divisional matchup with a 19-yard run on the Colts' first play from scrimmage. After that, the star running back, who is surrounded by trade rumors, did very little. This one got out of hand early for the Colts, as they trailed 28-0 going into halftime. That led to fewer touches for Taylor and, easily, his weakest output of the season for fantasy managers.

news.body: The Panthers opened the practice window of RB Jonathon Brooks.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (core) has practice window opened
news.impact: Brooks will have 21 days to officially be activated.

news.body: Panthers coach Dave Canales said RB Jonathon Brooks could have his practice window opened this week.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (core) could have practice window opened this week
news.impact: Canales added that Brooks still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks (core) is expected to be sidelined for around 6-8 weeks.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (core) expected to miss 6-8 weeks
news.impact: The Panthers recently placed Brooks on injured reserve due to a core injury that he suffered last week. HC Dave Canales told reporters that he is expected to be sidelined for 6-8 weeks, which puts him in line for a return sometime in November. Chuba Hubbard is now expected to be Carolina's workhorse running back for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks (core) was officially placed on IR on Wednesday.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (core) officially on IR
news.impact: Brooks had core muscle surgery on Wednesday and will be out for at least four weeks on IR. The 23-year-old's timetable is actually projected to be around six weeks. Chuba Hubbard will continue to shoulder the load ouf of the backfield for the Panthers.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed for 35 yards on six carries and added just seven yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jordan Mason totals 42 yards on Monday night
news.impact: Mason missed a large chunk of the season early on. Then, he returned to gain 68 yards on 15 carries in a win over the Colts in Week 7. Any encouragement that resulted from that performance is gone now, as the Vikings just cannot get things together on offense. Mason has gained 55 yards on just 14 carries combined over the last two games. He's a bench stash for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Jordan Mason bottled up in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Mason struggled to find running room in a losing effort, finishing with under 50 rushing yards for the first time in three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jordan Mason ran for 68 yards on 15 carries in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Mason leads Vikings backfield in return Sunday
news.impact: Mason did not start the game, but he was on the field more and saw more opportunity than Aaron Jones. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Lions.

news.body: Jordan Mason (thumb) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mason seems to be trending the right direction for Week 7, as he was not limited in any way in his first official practice back on Wednesday. If he plays and has no workload restrictions this week, fantasy managers should consider starting him in a favorable matchup against the Colts.

news.body: Packers RB Josh Jacobs could return in 2-to-3 weeks.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) could return in 2-to-3 weeks
news.impact: Jacobs will have surgery later this week on his broken ring finger. The Packers will decide on Saturday if an IR stint is necessary.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (finger) will undergo surgery this week according to Matt Zenitz.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) to undergo surgery
news.impact: Jacobs could miss a maximum of three weeks after suffering the injury in Sunday’s win over the Patriots according to Zenitz. Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong Jr. are in line for increased touches out of the Green Bay backfield unless another running back is added ahead of a Week 10 divisional matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs suffered a broken finger in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Josh Jacobs suffers broken finger Sunday, status uncertain
news.impact: LaFleur added that the hope is that Jacobs can play with the injury, but the team is evaluating him further. His status will need to be further evaluated this upcoming week.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (hand) is questionable to return for the Green Bay Packers Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (hand) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Jacobs suffered the hand injury late in the first quarter, rushing four times for five yards prior to exiting. Pierre Strong Jr. will take over in the backfield against the Patriots.

news.body: Justice Hill ran nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday. He also caught three passes for seven yards.
news.head: Justice Hill breaks away for long TD in loss
news.impact: Hill managed the one explosive play by the Ravens all night, breaking away for a long touchdown late in the game. He could be an interesting flex option moving forward as the Ravens change of pace back.

news.body: Justice Hill (groin) is set to play in Thursday night's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Justice Hill (groin) set to play Thursday
news.impact: Hill is managing a minor ankle issue right now, but he carries no injury designation for Thursday and should be a full go against the Jaguars. Fantasy managers can't really trust him on a week-to-week basis at this point in the season, however.

news.body: Justice Hill was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Justice Hill (groin) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Hill will remain in his change-of-pace role behind Derrick Henry for Thursday’s game against the Jaguars.

news.body: Justice Hill rushed for 15 yards on three carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught 4-of-8 targets for 20 yards.
news.head: Justice Hill sees seven touches in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Hill continues to see limited carries, but remains a factor in the passing game. His eight targets are a season high and he could be in line for more with a rookie Joe Fagnano potentially starting in Week 9.

news.body: Kaelon Black ran for 70 yards on 11 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Kaelon Black runs for 70 yards Sunday
news.impact: Black led San Francisco in rushing despite seeing seven fewer carries than Christian McCaffrey. He did not see a target in the passing game. He remains a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

news.body: Kaelon Black carried the ball eight times for 34 yards while catching his lone target for a three-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Kaelon Black sees nine touches in MNF win
news.impact: Black looked good playing behind Christian McCaffrey, averaging 4.3 yards per carry for the 49ers. The rookie remains one of the top handcuffs in fantasy heading into a Week 7 matchup vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Kaelon Black ran for 16 yards on six carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: Kaelon Black sees six carries Sunday
news.impact: Black remains a pure stash for fantasy managers.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson carried the ball 14 times for a team-leading 68 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson reaches end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Johnson took advantage of increased touches after Josh Jacobs (hand) exited, rushing for over 60 yards for the first time this season. The running back could be in line for increased touches if Jacobs is to miss time entering a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson is inactive for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson inactive for Week 7
news.impact: Johnson will not suit up after just one touch in Week 6, with the returning Josh Jacobs (suspension) poised to reclaim his role as the No. 1 option in the Green Bay backfield moving forward.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson lost two yards on his lone carry in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson sees just one carry in Week 6
news.impact: Johnson was an afterthought in the Green Bay offense with Pierre Strong Jr. seeing 11 carries and MarShawn Lloyd handling 10. The veteran can be dropped in all leagues heading into Week 7's matchup vs. the Lions.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson rushed seven times for 26 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson quiet in Week 5
news.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact out of the Green Bay backfield to this point, finishing with less than 45 rushing yards in each of his four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: Keaton Mitchell rushed the ball seven times for 33 yards and caught 3-fo-4 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Keaton Mitchell totals 66 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell was able to contribute well on Sunday. He totaled 66 yards on his ten touches, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, so he still didn't have a good fantasy total. He shouldn't be rostered for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Keaton Mitchell rushed the ball four times for six yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Keaton Mitchell uninvolved in loss Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell didn't see many opportunities on Sunday. He touched the ball just four times and was only able to turn that into six yards, which left him with an extremely poor fantasy total. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Keaton Mitchell rushed twice for four yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Keaton Mitchell Quiet in Week 6 Loss
news.impact: Mitchell was an afterthought in a three-man backfield, finishing well behind Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal in carries. His explosiveness gives him some upside if his role grows, but two touches aren't enough to justify putting him into fantasy lineups.

news.body: Keaton Mitchell rushed for 11 yards on six carries and gained 18 yards on three receptions in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Keaton Mitchell totals 29 yards on nine touches in Week 5
news.impact: The time share between Mitchell, Omarion Hampton, and Kimani Vidal in the Chargers' backfield continued Sunday. Mitchell did not do much with his nine touches, particularly on the ground. However, he has shown big-play ability in his career, and he's getting ample opportunities.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 102 yards and one touchdown on 18 carries in a 35-12 win over the Jets. He caught all four of his targets for 41 yards and two touchdowns
news.head: Kenneth Walker III finds the end zone three times in Week 9 win
news.impact: Walker bounced back after struggling against Denver and Seattle over the last two weeks. Walker eclipsed 100 rushing yards for the fifth time this season and logged his third game of the season with at least one rushing and one receiving touchdown. Walker and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed 21 times for 69 yards while catching four of five targets for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III totals 84 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Walker had 25 touches and accounted for 21 of Kansas City's 24 rushing attempts. That's the good. The bad? He averaged 3.3 yards per carry and failed to score. The workload is enough to keep Walker in fantasy lineups even when the production isn't there.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 14 times for 36 yards and caught four of his five targets for 21 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III held in check by Seahawks in Week 7
news.impact: Walker's 21 receiving yards were good enough for third on the Chiefs in receiving, which gives a good idea of how things went for the team's offense in the loss. The veteran running back has notched eight all-purpose touchdowns this season as the Chiefs' lead back. One of the top running backs in fantasy this season, Walker will be a locked-in RB1 in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed 19 times for 128 yards and two touchdowns while catching two of three targets for 11 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III Runs for 128 Yards, Two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Walker scored from 33 and two yards out while averaging 6.7 yards per carry. He also accounted for 19 of the Chiefs' 27 rushing attempts. There isn't much to question with that combination of workload and production. Walker remains a high-end RB1 going forward.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell carried the ball five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell posts 60 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Gainwell finished second on the team in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 44-yard reception. The veteran tailback has carved out a solid role behind Bucky Irving in Tampa, running for 305 yards while adding 15 catches for 121 yards and a touchdown in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 140 yards on 25 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees 25 carries Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell and Bucky Irving combined for 310 rushing yards on 52 carries on a day where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. He'll be an RB3/RB4 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell (hip) is officially active for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Brianna Dix.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) active for Week 8
news.impact: Gainwell will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Tampa Bay backfield that will utilize both Gainwell and Bucky Irving against the Falcons Sunday.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: The Buccaneers did not have any elevations from their practice squad. Gainwell remains listed as questionable, but he will likely be available for Sunday.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball seven times for 30 yards and caught 1-of-3 targets for six yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Kimani Vidal quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Vidal saw a solid amount of touches on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them and ended with just 36 scoreless yards against the Texans. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball eight times for 23 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Kimani Vidal leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Vidal ended as the team's leading rusher on Sunday, but that didn't really mean much. He finished with just 23 yards on the ground, and he ran a an inefficient clip of just 2.9 yards per carry over the course of the game. Fantasy managers should not have any real expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed seven times for 21 yards, while catching three of four targets for 19 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Kimani Vidal Records 40 Total Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Vidal matched Omarion Hampton with seven carries and actually finished with more rushing yards. Hampton still had the advantage in total touches, 11-10, making this look more like a committee than a changing of the guard. Vidal is worth rostering, but the split limits his immediate ceiling.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed for 57 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Kimani Vidal finds the end zone in Week 5 loss
news.impact: This stat line appears to suggest Vidal had a solid day on limited touches. In reality, it just reflects one big 42-yard touchdown run late in the third quarter. Vidal has now scored in each of the last two weeks, as he caught a touchdown in Week 4. Still, he's sharing the backfield work with both Omarion Hampton and Keaton Mitchell, so Vidal's fantasy value is capped.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play in Sunday night’s contest between the Chicago Bears and Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play Sunday
news.impact: Monangai will remain sidelined once again, as the running back is expected to return in Week 11 according to Rapoport. Roschon Johnson should once again fill the No. 2 running back role behind starter D’Andre Swift against the Buccaneers for head coach Ben Johnson Sunday night.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) is questionable to play in Sunday night's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Monangai has been out for several weeks while managing these two injuries, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday night. We won't know whether or not that's the case until closer to game time, but his workload would be less than ideal for the workload of D'Andre Swift moving forward and would push Roschon Johnson back to RB3 in the team's rotation.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Monangai has already been sidelined for several weeks due to a pair of issues that he's dealing with, and he wasn't able to practice on Thursday as a result. He seems unlikely to play in Week 9, which will leave Roschon Johnson as Chicago's Rb2 behind D'Andre Swift for another game.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) has been ruled out for Week 8 for the Chicago Bears according to Courtney Cronin.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) ruled out for Week 8
news.impact: Monangai will miss a fourth consecutive contest while continuing to work towards a return to the Chicago backfield for head coach Ben Johnson, with D’Andre Swift in line for the majority of running back touches against the Seahawks Monday night.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed 15 times for 45 yards and caught three passes for 16 yards in Sunday’s win over the Commanders.
news.head: Kyren Williams totals 61 scoreless yards in win
news.impact: Kyren out-touched fellow running back Blake Corum 18 to 11 in the contest, but only recorded 3 more all-purpose yards. Despite the down game, Williams remains a locked-and-loaded RB1 for Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Kyren Williams finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Williams contributed well on Sunday. He was able to churn out 56 yards and a touchdown on the ground, but he wasn't able to contribute much in the passing game, which hurt his fantasy total. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward, though the increasing involvement of Blake Corum isn't what fantasy managers want to see.

news.body: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 99 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in both of his targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads backfield in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in three of his last four contests. The running back remains one of the more explosive offensive options as part of an injury-ravaged Rams offense for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball ten times for 50 yards and caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Williams saw 16 opportunities on Sunday, but he was a bit disappointing with them, racking up 67 yards without a touchdown in the team's loss to the Cardinals. After the game he voiced some frustrations about the timeshare the team currently has in the backfield, but fantasy managers shouldn't be too concerned about him moving forward and should continue to start him without reservation for the foreseeable future.

news.body: The Patriots signed RB Lan Larison.
news.head: Lan Larison signs with Patriots
news.impact: Larison will add depth in the backfield for New England.

news.body: Lan Larison appears to be the early favorite to be the RB3 in the Patriots backfield.
news.head: Lan Larison remains early favorite to be Patriots' RB3
news.impact: The same report was also made earlier in the Patriots offseason program. Daniels notes that Larison got a lot of reps on Monday with Drake Maye’s unit. Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson should still continue to dominate the snaps.

news.body: Lan Larison was reportedly the clear No. 3 running back for the Patriots behind Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Lan Larison 'clear' No. 3 RB for Patriots at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Larison was an undrafted free agent last year. He is likely to compete with Jam Miller for the RB3 role in the Patriots backfield.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) is inactive for Week 9 for the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) inactive for Week 9
news.impact: Lloyd will not suit up after being unable to clear through pregame tests, with Josh Jacobs to handle the majority of the backfield work anyways against the Patriots Sunday.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: The Packers may be without their backup running back on Sunday. Lloyd is dealing with a knee issue right now and is currently considered questionable to play as a result. If he's ruled out, Chris Brooks (ankle) may see more work as a result of his absence.

news.body: Marshawn Lloyd gained seven yards on three carries, adding in a nine-yard reception during Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Marshawn Lloyd not much of a factor Thursday night
news.impact: Josh Jacobs is completely back as the workhorse for the Packers' offense, so Lloyd is nothing more than a backup now. He may carry some fantasy appeal for those who have Jacobs, but that's even suspect with the Packers' seeming inability to run the ball with much success.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd rushed the ball six times for 20 yards and caught two passes for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Lloyd was still somewhat involved on Sunday and saw eight opportunities, but he wasn't able to do much with them and was entirely outshined by Josh Jacobs in his first game back. There doesn't seem to be much optimism surrounding Lloyd's role or fantasy outlook for the foreseeable future with Jacobs now back in the lineup.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. ran for -3 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. struggles Sunday
news.impact: One week after taking over the workhorse role in the Raiders backfield, Washington and Ashton Jeanty both saw six carries on Sunday. He draws a tough Seahawks run defense next week.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed for 83 yards on 25 carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. sees 25 rushing attempts in Week 8 win
news.impact: Washington saw 25 carries to Ashton Jeanty's two rushing attempts in the win. Head coach Klint Kubiak stated after the game that the reduced workload for Jeanty was by design. Fantasy managers should expect Washington to continue to be involved in the running game heading into Week 9 against the 49ers.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed six times for a team-high 27 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. leads quiet backfield in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Washington Jr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 50 yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains more of a valuable handcuff option for Ashton Jeanty owners ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is active for Week 7 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) active for Week 7
news.impact: Washington Jr. is good to go after clearing through pregame testing without any issues, boosting a Las Vegas backfield as a complementary option behind bellcow Ashton Jeanty against the Rams Sunday.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 16 times for 55 yards while also hauling in his lone target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II leads backfield in Week 9 loss to Lions
news.impact: Gordon II has capitalized on increased touches out of the Miami backfield of late, logging over 60 offensive yards in each of his last five contests. The running back remains one of the few stable options as part of an underwhelming Miami offense to this point ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 19 times for 69 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He also failed to catch his only target.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards in loss
news.impact: After four straight weeks with a rushing touchdown and three straight weeks of 88+ rushing yards, Gordon finally had himself a down game. That's to be expected for a player who has almost zero passing game involvement; the floor falls out when receiving is nil. He will face off against the Lions next weekend.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed for 103 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He caught 1-of-3 targets for no yards.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Gordon has scored in four straight games and tallied 80+ rushing yards in three straight contests. Jaylen Wright exited the game with a quad injury, which could to Gordon seeing plenty of work again in Week 8 if Wright is unable to play against New England.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball 18 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gordon was Miami's leading rusher on Sunday, finishing with 88 yards and a touchdown while maintaining an efficient clip of 4.9 yards per carry. He saw no opportunities in the receiving game, however, which severely hindered his upside. That will be a problem for his week-to-week consistency moving forward if the team makes no efforts to get him involved as a receiver.

news.body: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 13 times for 60 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Omarion Hampton leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Hampton led the backfield in carries on Sunday and was able to rush for a team-high 60 yards. His efficiency wasn't bad, but he didn't get in the end zone and didn't catch any passes, so his fantasy total remained poor. It's encouraging to see the team finally consolidating some work for him, but he is unlikely to be relevant anytime soon with how pitiful their offense continues to look.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball nine times for 20 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Omarion Hampton disappoints again in loss Sunday
news.impact: Hampton hasn't been able to get anything going over the course of the season, and Sunday was no exception. He totaled just 27 yards on his 11 touches and wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He should not be started in nearly any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards while catching all four of his targets for 21 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Omarion Hampton Totals 39 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Hampton averaged just 2.6 yards per carry, but the bigger concern is the workload. Kimani Vidal also received seven carries and finished with seven touches compared to Hampton's 11. The four receptions helped Hampton in PPR formats, but a split backfield on an 0-6 offense isn't an ideal fantasy situation.

news.body: Omarion Hampton gained only 33 yards on 14 carries, adding a six-yard reception during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Omarion Hampton held under 40 yards on 15 touches
news.impact: Much to the chagrin of fantasy managers, Hampton continues to share the backfield load with Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell. Hampton had at least found the end zone in three of the first four weeks, but he failed to do so in Week 5. The second-year back is averaging only 3.7 yards on his nearly 15 carries per game, and he's basically become an afterthought in the Chargers' passing attack.

news.body: Pierre Strong Jr. rushed eight times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 11 yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Pierre Strong Jr. quiet in Week 9
news.impact: Strong Jr. has struggled to make an impact out of the Green Bay backfield of late, logging less than 35 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust as more of a change-of-pace backfield option to this point, with a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Pierre Strong Jr. carried the ball 11 times for 28 yards and caught five of his six targets for 39 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Pierre Strong Jr. leads Green Bay backfield in Week 6
news.impact: Strong led the Green Bay backfield in the win. The veteran has now played two games for the Packers, posting 35 rushing yards while catching eight passes for 50 yards. He is now looking like the running back to roster in Green Bay, at least until Josh Jacobs returns. Strong will face off against the Lions in Week 7.

news.body: Pierre Strong Jr. rushed five times for seven yards while also catching three of his four targets for 11 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Pierre Strong Jr. sees eight touches in Week 5
news.impact: Strong Jr. struggled to make an impact in his first game action of the season, averaging just 1.4 yards per carry in a winning effort. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: Pierre Strong Jr. is practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Pierre Strong Jr. (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Strong missed time last week. He is on the Packers practice squad.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran 15 times for 43 yards in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday. He also caught his only target for two yards.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins struggles to get going against Saints defense
news.impact: This was a prime spot for Judkins to go off, and he didn't. The Saints had been one of the best matchups for running backs this season, and Judkins failed to deliver. He's only been above 10 PPR points twice this season and is a low-end RB3 option at best until he shows signs of life.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday
news.impact: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins carried the ball 17 times for 96 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for an eight-yard gain in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins scores twice in Week 7 win
news.impact: Judkins turned in one of his better games as a pro, finding the end zone on runs of five and six yards in the win. He looked good after missing the previous week with an ankle injury. Judkins now has three rushing touchdowns across six contests this season. He will be on the RB2 radar in Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 7 for the Cleveland Browns according to Mary Kay Cabot.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) off injury report for Week 7
news.impact: Judkins is good to go after increasing reps in practice throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken, setting the running back up to lead a Cleveland backfield that could be missing Dylan Sampson (knee) against the Titans Sunday.

news.body: Rachaad White rushed seven times for 28 yards and caught two passes for 41 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Rachaad White rushes for 28 yards, adds 41 through the air in loss
news.impact: White had a near 50-50 split with Austin Ekeler, but outproduced him by 35 yards. Next up, the Commanders will face the Giants on Thursday Night Football, where White will end up in the RB3/flex range.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of his three targets for five yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: White found the end zone for the second straight game as he punched in a one-yard score to put the game out of reach with 1:52 left in regulation. White has been a solid fantasy running back while leading the Washington backfield with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve and should continue to be in fantasy lineups in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball seven times for 27 yards and caught four of his five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: White had a larger role than usual with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve with a groin injury. White took advantage, leading the Washington backfield in touches while scoring on a nine-yard pass from Jayden Daniels in the fourth quarter. White is looking like a high-end RB3 in fantasy going forward as he heads into his bye in Week 7.

news.body: Rachaad White was wearing a non-contact jersey in practice on Friday.
news.head: Rachaad White (shoulder) in non-contact jersey in practice
news.impact: White was listed as a full participant in practice on Thursday. He'll need to be monitored to see if he gets downgraded on Friday.

news.body: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson dealing with knee tendon issue
news.impact: Stevenson is not expected to require surgery but it could sideline him for a short period of time. Corey Kiner would figure to lead the Patriots backfield if TreVeyon Henderson remains sidelined.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball six times for 32 yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 46 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson scores once in loss Sunday
news.impact: It was concerning that Stevenson saw less carries than Corey Kiner on Sunday, but he was able to cover that up by producing well in the passing game, which left him with a respectable fantasy total overall. It's worth keeping an eye on if he's losing his grip as the team's top rusher with TreVeyon Henderson out of the lineup.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson ran 19 times for 82 yards and caught three passes for eight yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson runs for 82 yards in win
news.impact: Stevenson led the Patriots backfield with TreVeyon Henderson sidelined, with the two other Patriots RBs combining for nine carries. He was also the only running back involved in the receiving game, further helping his modest fantasy total. He gets the Packers next weekend.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson gained just 22 yards on six carries, but hauled in all five of his targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson delivers in passing game Thursday night
news.impact: Stevenson's six carries were a team high Thursday night, but the Patriots just did not do much on the ground. More importantly for fantasy managers, Stevenson also led the team in receiving yards. The veteran running back scored on a 48-yard passing play, and he was far more involved than TreVeyon Henderson. Stevenson will remain in the RB2 or Flex range for Week 8.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Rico Dowdle finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle saw a fairly decent role behind Jaylen Warren in Sunday's win. He'll be on the RB3 radar moving forward if his current role holds.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran 9 times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rico Dowdle snags six passes in win
news.impact: Dowdle really saw his numbers come up in this game after a disappointing outing against Tampa Bay. Not that his efficiency running the ball was bad then, but he simply didn't receive many opportunities. Dowdle is looking like an RB3 type of play moving forward.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7
news.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back was limited for another practice session on Thursday as he continues to manage a knee injury of some kind. He was able to play through it last week, however, so the expectation is that he will do the same again in Week 7.

news.body: RJ Harvey (knee) was placed on IR with a designation to return.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) placed on short-term IR
news.impact: Harvey sustained a knee injury at practice earlier this week. He will now be forced to miss at least the next four games. JK Dobbins and Jonah Coleman could see more touches as a result.

news.body: RJ Harvey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Harvey was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should both step into bigger roles in the Broncos backfield.

news.body: RJ Harvey (knee) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) added to injury report Thursday
news.impact: Harvey is a new addition to Denver's injury report, being listed with a knee issue of some kind that left him limited at practice. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as J.K. Dobbins and rookie Jonah Coleman will both see more work if Harvey is sidelined against the Chiefs.

news.body: RJ Harvey rushed three times for six yards, while catching both of his targets for 54 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7
news.head: RJ Harvey Scores 52-Yard Touchdown in Week 7
news.impact: Harvey turned a short pass from Bo Nix into a 52-yard touchdown for his biggest play of the afternoon. The touchdown saved an otherwise quiet day, as Harvey received just five touches with Jonah Coleman returning to the lineup. Harvey remains involved as a receiver, but Coleman's return adds another player to an already crowded Denver backfield. The former is in flex territory.

news.body: Samaje Perine carried the ball four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for a nine-yard gain in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Samaje Perine sees five touches in Week 8
news.impact: Perine was quiet in the high-scoring win while Chase Brown racked up 20 touches. The veteran tailback saw 14 carries for the Bengals two games ago but he has taken a backseat to Brown ever since. Perine will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed for 16 yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 35-13 2in over the Ravens.
news.head: Samaje Perine finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Perine plunged into the end zone on a one-yard rush early in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. The veteran continues to see limited work and can remain off fantasy managers' radar for now.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball 14 times for 68 yards and caught two passes for ten yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Samaje Perine leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Perine had a good game on Sunday. He was Cincinnati's leading rusher against the Dolphins and actually saw more overall carries than Chase Brown, who usually acts as the team's RB1. The veteran could be relevant moving forward if he can continue to accumulate significant touches on this offense moving forward.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball three times for seven yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Samaje Perine uninvolved in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran didn't do much on Sunday, finishing with just seven yards in the team's loss to the Jaguars. He is clearly the team's backup at this point and doesn't project to be an effective fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball 13 times for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Barkley was able to get into the end zone once on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do anything outside of that. He finished with just 22 yards over the course of the game and didn't catch a single pass, which really hurt his fantasy total. He will be an unreliable starter for as long as Joe Milton III remains the starting quarterback for Philadelphia moving forward.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Barkley is still dealing with the nagging effects of a hamstring and back issue, but he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will play against the Giants. The team may still limit his workload, but he will continue to have explosive week-to-week upside every time he's on the field, even if that upside seems harder to attain now with Joe Milton III set to start at quarterback for the Eagles.

news.body: Saquon Barkley is practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley practicing Thursday
news.impact: Barkley is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against his former team in the Giants. He'll remain on the RB2 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Saquon Barkley told reporters he was told by the Eagles that he would not be traded.
news.head: Saquon Barkley says he will not be traded
news.impact: Despite the Eagles falling to 2-6 on the season, it appears Barkley will not be going anywhere. There had been trade rumors of him potentially being moved before this year's deadline.

news.body: Seth McGowan carried the ball six times for 45 yards and a touchdown while losing three yards on his lone reception in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Seth McGowan finds the end zone in Week 9
news.impact: McGowan punched in a two-yard touchdown in the first quarter to give the Colts their first points of the game. The rookie running back could be the team's starting running back in Week 10 against the Dolphins if the Colts wind up trading Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's trade deadline. McGowan would be a locked-in RB2 in fantasy for Week 10 if that were to happen.

news.body: Seth McGowan gained 29 yards on five carries in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Seth McGowan gets five carries in Sunday's loss
news.impact: McGowan's name, rightly so, has been increasingly popping up on the fantasy radar as trade rumors have built around Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor. Sunday's game got out of hand by halftime, so the Colts mostly went away from the running game. However, if Taylor is indeed traded away, McGowan could see plenty of work during the second half of the season. The rookie out of Kentucky has averaged 4.4 yards on 37 total carries so far.

news.body: Seth McGowan ran for 46 yards on 11 carries in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings. He also caught his lone target for two yards receiving.
news.head: Seth McGowan sees 11 carries Sunday
news.impact: McGowan saw a season-high in carries, his first time reaching double-digit carries. He is an intriguing stash for fantasy managers with Jonathan Taylor continuing to have his name brought up in trade rumors.

news.body: Seth McGowan ran four times for 27 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Seth McGowan runs for 27 yards in loss
news.impact: McGowan is once again playing backup to Jonathan Taylor, which is unlikely to change. Keep him stashed on your bench if you have Taylor.

news.body: Sione Vaki rushed three times for 14 yards while also catching both of his targets for seven yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
news.head: Sione Vaki sees five touches in Week 9
news.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the Detroit backfield, recording less than 25 offensive yards in four of his last five games. The running back remains more of a handcuff option to No. 1 running back Jahmyr Gibbs ahead of a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 9 for the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 9
news.impact: Vaki is good to go after passing through pregame checks, as the running back will look to take advantage of a complementary role behind superstar No.1 running back Jahmyr Gibbs against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.body: Sione Vaki (ankle) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Sione Vaki (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Vaki is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with some kind of an ankle issue. Jacob Saylors (neck) is also questionable to play, so it's uncertain who will be available to play the RB2 role behind Jahmyr Gibbs for the Lions this week.

news.body: Sione Vaki was not seen at Lions practice on Friday.
news.head: Sione Vaki not seen at practice Friday
news.impact: It is unclear what the reason is for Vaki's absence. He'll need to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: The Titans are not trading RB Tony Pollard.
news.head: Tony Pollard will not be traded
news.impact: Pollard will remain in Tennessee the rest of the season. He should remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tony Pollard carried the ball 21 times for 117 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his five targets for 20 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Tony Pollard stays hot with two TDs in Week 8
news.impact: Pollard found the end zone twice, on runs of one and 40 yards, giving him five rushing touchdowns over his past two contests. Overall, Pollard has rushed for 595 yards and six touchdowns in eight games. He is settling in as a solid RB2 in fantasy heading into his Week 9 bye.

news.body: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tony Pollard was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard not seen practicing Thursday
news.impact: It is unclear what the reasoning is for Pollard's absence. He'll need to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve
news.impact: The Saints have decided to place Etienne on injured reserve, which means that he is going to be sidelined for at least the next four weeks. He may be out longer than that as well, but the team has yet to place a concrete timetable on his recovery. Look for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller to both shoulder a much bigger workload in this backfield for the foreseeable future as a result of his absence.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Travis Etienne Jr. “will miss time."
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to miss extended time
news.impact: Etienne does not hold a clear timetable to return. Alvin Kamara should take on a bigger role in the Saints backfield with Kendre Miller also taking on a bigger role behind him.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. exited Sunday’s contest between the New Orleans Saints against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ross Jackson.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. exits early Sunday
news.impact: Etienne Jr. headed to the locker room for further evaluation, rushing 13 times for 57 yards while also hauling in both of his targets for 13 yards prior to exiting. Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take over backfield duties in the running back’s absence.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. has been cleared for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Etienne has been dealing with a hamstring injury this week. He'll be a risky RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Henderson will not suit while continuing to battle ongoing illness issues for head coach Mike Vrabel, with Rhamondre Stevenson once again expected to receive a sizeable workload out of the New England backfield against the Packers Sunday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Henderson is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Henderson did not play last week. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Week 8 for the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 8
news.impact: Henderson will sit out while continuing to battle an illness that kept the running back from practicing throughout the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will receive as many touches as he can handle out of the backfield against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.body: Ty Johnson rushed one time for just one yard but gained 36 yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Ty Johnson goes for 37 yards on three touches in Week 9
news.impact: It's well known that Johnson makes the vast majority of his contributions to the Bills as a receiver out of the backfield. That was the case again Monday night. He didn't do much on two of his touches, but he took one of his receptions 36 yards top give him the game's longest gain. Johnson doesn't carry much fantasy appeal outside the deepest of PPR leagues.

news.body: Ty Johnson rushed for four yards on four carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards.
news.head: Ty Johnson sees eight touches in Week 8
news.impact: Johnson continues to serve as a change-of-pace back to James Cook in the Bills' offense. His fantasy value remains limited heading into a tough matchup with the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Ty Johnson (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: Johnson was able to practice on Thursday, though he was limited by a hamstring injury again. It seems likely that he will be active and continue to play a depth role for the Bills again in Week 6.

news.body: Ty Johnson (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited Wednesday
news.impact: Johnson was left limited at practice on Wednesday due to a hamstring injury that he's still managing. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 6, however, unless he suffers a setback at some point in the week.

news.body: Tyjae Spears has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Spears missed practice all week. Tony Pollard will remain in a workhorse role.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) is not practicing for the Tennessee Titans Friday according to Turron Davenport.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Spears has struggled to take the field throughout the week for head coach Robert Saleh, leaving the running back’s status in question for Sunday. Tony Pollard would be in line for even more touches if Spears is unable to suit up.

news.body: Tyjae Spears missed practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Spears missed a second straight practice. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

news.body: Tyjae Spears did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Spears will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 46 yards on 17 carries in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for zero yards receiving.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier sees 17 carries Sunday
news.impact: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all five of his targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier dynamic in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Allgeier took advantage of an Arizona backfield attack that lost Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, rushing for over 50 yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The running back could be in line for a sizeable workload if both Love and Knight remain sidelined for a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier will return to his depth role with Jeremiyah Love slated to return.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allgeier is dealing with a toe injury. Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.

news.body: Woody Marks rushed the ball 18 times for 70 yards and caught one pass for four yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Woody Marks leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Marks served as the team's top RB on Sunday. He finished with the most rushing yards out of anybody on the team, but he left a lot to be desired with his efficiency and lack of involvement in the receiving game. He will see a decrease in opportunities whenever David Montgomery (groin) is back in the lineup for Houston.

news.body: Woody Marks ran for 66 yards on 19 carries in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants. He also caught his lone target for 15 yards receiving.
news.head: Woody Marks totals 20 touches Sunday
