news.impact: Bell caught his first pass since Week 3, but was not heavily featured in the Dolphins' passing attack. Fantasy managers should look elsewhere for wide receiver production for now.

news.body: Chris Bell failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Chris Bell held catchless in loss Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a terrible showing on Sunday, being held without a catch for a second-straight week. He was able to pick up 26 yards on his lone rush attempt, but that did nothing to fix his lack of production as a receiver. He should not be started in nearly any league format at this point in the season.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught two of his three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard run in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Godwin was quiet in the loss in what has been a disappointing year for him. He is still looking for his first touchdown of the season while failing to go over 46 receiving yards in any of his nine games. Droppable in 12-team leagues, Godwin will be on bye in Week 10 before he takes on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass in the win on Sunday. Godwin has struggled all season regardless of the circumstances. He'll be a WR4/WR5 moving forward.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes in win
news.impact: While the final stat line is a bit disappointing considering Emeka Egbuka did not play, it's important to remember Baker Mayfield threw only 11 passes for 64 yards. Godwin had a 45% target share and a 42% receiving yards share with those numbers. So again, nothing much to write home about in the final box score, but his actual market share was great. He could be interesting next week against the Falcons

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-8 targets for 37 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Godwin was second on the team in targets, but it didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 7 of 12 targets for 98 yards in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave sees 12 targets in win over Browns
news.impact: Olave was hard at work in this one, more than doubling up the next closest Saint in targets, which was rookie Jordyn Tyson. He also nearly doubled up the next closest Saint in yardage and had three more receptions than any other. It was his best yardage total in a month, and he will look to keep things up against the Panthers next week.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 4-of-7 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

news.body: Christian Watson hauled in seven of his eight targets for 171 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson finds end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Watson has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 115 receiving yards in three of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic offensive options in the Green Bay offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Watson suffered a broken rib last week, but it's not going to prevent him from playing this week and he is officially good to go for Sunday's game. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him this week in what projects to be a high-scoring affair in New England this weekend.

news.body: Christian Watson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Watson is continuing to trend towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Watson suffered a rib injury in Green Bay's win over the Panthers last week, which left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's on track to be a full go for Week 9, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 3-of-4 targets for 32 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Cooper Kupp totals 32 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kupp had a couple of big receptions from Drew Lock in the middle of the field. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught one pass for seven yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Cooper Kupp finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Kupp was able to catch a touchdown on Monday night, but that was his only reception, so he still had a terrible fantasy total over the course of the game. He remains entirely off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 20 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Kupp was quiet just one week after drawing 10 targets vs. the Broncos. The veteran wideout continues to operate as Seattle's No. 2 receiver, although the majority of the work goes to Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Kupp will be a low-end flex option in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught five of ten targets for 50 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 50 yards in loss
news.impact: Kupp had arguably his best game of the season, with season-highs in targets, receptions, and yards, lacking only a touchdown. He is a bit of a risky start most weeks, as his volume has been low for the most part. A near 20% target share this week is a nice sign of life, but we will need to see more consistency to really feel comfortable starting him.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Sutton scored from three yards out in the first quarter for his first touchdown since Week 1. He also led Denver with nine targets, nearly doubling his four targets from Week 8. That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
news.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches two passes in win
news.impact: Sutton was quiet in this game, though there wasn't much to go around when the team combined for 107 passing yards. It's been a rough start to the year for QB Bo Nix, and until he improves, the pass catchers will suffer.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Davante Adams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Davante Adams off injury report Monday
news.impact: Adams received a rest day in practice during the week. He'll remain a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) is expected to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to be limited Wednesday
news.impact: Samuel has been out for a while due to a nagging hamstring issue, but he is going to return to practice on Wednesday and is expected to be a limited participant. He will have a chance to play in Week 10, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said he expects Deebo Samuel Sr. to return to practice this week.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to practice this week
news.impact: Samuel will have a chance to return in Week 10 against the Cowboys. Mike Evans is expected to remain sidelined.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Samuel Sr. will sit out once again for head coach Kyle Shanahan with an eye towards returning in Week 10, with Brandin Cooks and Demarcus Robinson (ankle) in line to lead a banged-up wideout group against the Raiders Sunday.

news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said it’s unlikely that Deebo Samuel Sr. will play in Week 9 against the Raiders.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) not expected to return in Week 9
news.impact: Mike Evans is also not expected to play. Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.body: Demarcus Robinson caught 3-of-4 targets for 22 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Demarcus Robinson catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Robinson was making his return from injured reserve. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) is active for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers.
news.head: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) active for Week 9
news.impact: Robinson will take the field after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, immediately sliding into a starting wide receiver slot for an injury-riddled pass-catching group for head coach Kyle Shanahan against the Raiders.

news.body: The 49ers activated WR Demarcus Robinson from injured reserve.
news.head: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) activated from IR
news.impact: Robinson will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

news.body: Demarcus Robinson is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
news.head: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: The 49ers are still expected to be without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 5-of-9 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Douglas was a bright spot for the Patriots on Sunday. He led the team with 102 yards on five catches, which left him with a good fantasy total despite him not getting into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a viable fantasy option for as long as A.J. Brown (knee) remains out of the lineup moving forward.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads Patriots WRs in win
news.impact: Douglas led the Patriots in receiving yards and tied for third on the team in targets with two other players: Hunter Henry and Rhamondre Stevenson. Douglas made his targets count, though, with a 48 yard score being the highlight of his night. Should AJ Brown continue to miss time, Douglas seems to be a safe bet for targets and production.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.

news.body: Denzel Boston did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Boston is sidelined to start the week due to a toe injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught six of seven targets for 98 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints in overtime on Sunday.
news.head: Denzel Boston goes for 98 yards in loss
news.impact: Boston had been quiet for the last several weeks, but got going again against the Saints. He's yet to rack up a 100-yard game, but he now has three games where he's accumulated at least 89 yards. He's more of a flex play right now, but he has the upside to be a WR2 on a given week.

news.body: Denzel Boston (calf) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Denzel Boston (calf) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, the rookie's calf injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 9. He's still a risky fantasy option on a week-to-week basis, however, especially with Shedeur Sanders set to be Cleveland's starting quarterback this week.

news.body: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (calf) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie was a limited participant on Wednesday. He's managing a calf issue right now, but it doesn't seem to be serious enough to threaten his availability for Week 9. If active on Sunday, his target share may look different with Shedeur Sanders set to be the starting quarterback for the Browns.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught two of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags two passes in win
news.impact: Vele was one of eight Saints players to catch a pass on Sunday, and he was tied for fourth in receptions. It's gonna be tough for Vele to find relevance with Jordyn Tyson now in the mix, so he can be dropped in most leagues.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Devaughn Vele totals 42 yards Sunday
news.impact: Vele was the second-leading receiver on the day for New Orleans. He is a borderline flex play in games where the passing volume is low for the Saints.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught four of his six targets for 26 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Devaughn Vele bottled up in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Vele has made an inconsistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout will look to get back on track for head coach Kellen Moore in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Smith was absent from another practice on Friday and has been ruled out for Sunday's game, which comes as no surprise. It's unclear how much longer he will need to recover from this hamstring issue, and Makai Lemon is expected to be Philadelphia's WR1 again this week with both Smith and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) set to be sidelined again.

news.body: DeVonta Smith is not practicing on Thursday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Smith is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.

news.body: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Smith will miss another game for the Eagles alongside Dontayvion Wicks. They both remain week-to-week.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not practicing for the Philadelphia Eagles Friday according to Jimmy Kempski.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Smith has yet to take the practice field for head coach Nick Sirianni, leaving the wideout’s status question entering the weekend.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards, adding 11 yards on one carry in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: DJ Moore totals 36 yards in Monday's win
news.impact: Moore had a big game in his return to action against the Ravens in Week 8. He couldn't replicate the effort in Week 9, but he is healthy and stronger fantasy performances should be on the way. Moore is best viewed as a low-end WR2 or high-end WR3.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-7 targets for 82 yards and a touchdown in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore hauls in TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Moore found the end zone on an 11-yard reception early in the fourth quarter. Moore did indicate after the game that he was fine after leaving the game late with a knee injury. Moore and the Bills take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 8
news.impact: Moore is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, boosting a Buffalo passing attack for quarterback Josh Allen against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is expected to play for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Moore looks poised to return from a two-game absence barring any pregame setbacks, offering quarterback Josh Allen an impactful pass-catching option against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 1-of-6 targets for four yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: DK Metcalf drops pass that leads to interception Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf dropped an open pass that was going for over 30 yards. He not only dropped the pass, but the ball also bounced off him and resulted in an interception. He is an upside WR3 with a low floor for fantasy managers.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught two of six targets for 56 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in big 51 yarder in win
news.impact: Metcalf has been very up and down this season, with a big 115 yard performance against Cleveland followed up by 12 yards the following week, then an 11-for-93 stat line last Sunday, and finally two for 56 this Sunday. He's a boom-bust receiver for now; if you can afford to let him have his ups and downs, then he's a fine start. But more than likely, he's a risky flex at best.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

news.body: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 47 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He rushed for 16 yards on one carry.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers hauls in two passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Meyers continues to operate as the third wide receiver in the offense, but has not seen more than three targets since Week 4. Fantasy managers can leave the rookie out of starting lineups heading into Week 10.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught all three of his targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers goes for 34 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers had a solid afternoon as the Bengals' No. 3 receiver. While he won't see much work stuck behind Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Meyers has shown that he has enough talent to earn a role in the NFL. He will now prepare to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for just 12 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Meyers has flashed some potential recently, but he wasn't able to build on his momentum on Sunday, finishing with just 12 yards in a win over the Dolphins. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high hopes that he will be fantasy relevant anytime soon.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 82 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers racks up 82 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Meyers stepped up in a big way on Sunday. He finished with 82 yards on seven catches against the Jaguars, although that wasn't enough to propel the Bengals to a win. They will likely need to rely on him more moving forward with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both currently at risk of missing time due to injuries.

news.body: Drake London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Drake London hauls in five passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: London lead the Falcons in receiving yards in the loss Sunday. London has been held in check over the last two weeks, posting just 76 receiving yards on six receptions. London and the Falcons will look to bounce back against the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Drake London hauled in four of his team-leading 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Drake London sees 10 targets in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: London continues to make the most of his role as the primary option in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack, registering 10 or more targets in three of the last four contests. The wideout will look to make a more explosive impact in a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Efton Chism III hauled in five passes for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Efton Chism III hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Chism played well on Sunday. He was able to catch all of his passes and rack up nearly 50 yards over the course of the afternoon, and he also got into the end zone once, which was the cherry on top. He has shown potential when given opportunities on this offense, but the eventual return of A.J. Brown (knee) will likely hurt that.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught all five of his targets for 37 yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Efton Chism III snags five passes in win
news.impact: Chism led the Patriots in targets and receptions in this game, posting a modest 37-yard total as a result. He could be back in as a sneaky PPR flex should AJ Brown continue to miss time, but his floor and ceiling seem to be fairly low at this point in time.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 5-of-6 targets for 57 yards in the Patriots win over the Raiders. He added two rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Efton Chism III hauls in five passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Chism led the team in targets with six, setting an new season high in targets, yards, and receptions. With Mack Hollins and AJ Brown on injured reserve, Chism appears to be carving out a role in the offense.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka caught three of his five targets for 38 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9. He also gained one yard on his lone rush in the loss.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Egbuka was dealing with a foot injury throughout the week and was listed as questionable for the game before ultimately suiting up. The second-year wideout has 31 catches for 278 yards and two touchdowns in seven games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play in Sunday’s matchup between night’s matchup between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Chicago Bears according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka progressed enough throughout the week after being limited to entering it, as the wideout looks to provide quarterback Baker Mayfield with an impactful pass-catching option against the Chicago Bears Sunday night.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka will head into the weekend with a questionable tag. It seems like there's a lot of optimism surrounding his status, but he is officially considered questionable to play at this point. It may be hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him this week, however, especially with him playing on Sunday night after the main slate of games.

news.body: Bucs coach Todd Bowles said Emeka Egbuka will be a game-time decision on Sunday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) to be game-time decision Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka was able to return to a full practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into the weekend.

news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said he’s “very hopeful” Garrett Wilson will play in Week 10 against the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) hopeful to play in Week 10
news.impact: Wilson was limited in practice on Wednesday to begin the week. He missed last week's game after getting banged up in Week 8. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Garrett Wilson (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday’s matchup between the New York Jets and Kansas City Chiefs according to Rich Cimini.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Wilson will be sidelined for head coach Aaron Glenn after being unable to progress through concussion issues throughout the week, setting up Adonai Mitchell and Omari Cooper for increased targets against the Chiefs Sunday.

news.body: Garrett Wilson was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Wilson continues to trend in the wrong direction to play this week as he remains in concussion protocol.

news.body: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Wilson was recently placed in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like a long shot that he will be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game, and if he's ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. should both see a substantial increase in opportunities in his absence.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Pickens has missed some time recently due to a hamstring issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it seems like his health is improving considerably. It remains to be seen if he will be ready to make his return to the lineup in Week 10, however, so fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor his status over the course of the practice week.

news.body: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he expects George Pickens to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Pickens was ruled out last week for Dallas. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his return.

news.body: Cowboys WR George Pickens (hamstring) is officially inactive for a Week 9 matchup with the Colts.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) officially inactive for Week 9
news.impact: Pickens was considered questionable to play this week. His absence will open up targets for Ryan Flournoy and Jake Ferguson against the Colts.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Pickens popped up on the injury report earlier in the week due to a hamstring issue, and it is going to leave him questionable to play heading into the weekend. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his status and should expect Jake Ferguson (ankle) and Ryan Flournoy to both benefit if the star wideout is unable to play against Indianapolis.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 5-of-5 targets for 30 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Germie Bernard catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Bernard hauled in all five targets that went his way. He remains in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers while Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson both remain sidelined.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Germie Bernard snags three passes in win over Saints
news.impact: After two great weeks in a row, Bernard was largely held in check by the Saints defense in this one, limited to three short yardage catches. There will be better days ahead, but one thing to keep note of is that the Steelers will have to start getting him some space downfield rather than the short dink-and-dunk targets he's had recently.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 11-of-12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Germie Bernard finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Bernard took full advantage of his extended opportunity with both Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve. He scored the wining touchdown in OT as well that he hauled in from Aaron Rodgers. He'll be on the WR3/flex range heading into next week against the Titans.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said 'football comes easy' to Germie Bernard.
news.head: Germie Bernard draws praise from HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: "He's acclimated very well to the offense, can play all three positions, and sticks his nose in there," McCarthy said. "I've been very impressed." Bernard is set to step into a bigger role with Roman Wilson week-to-week.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in Week 9 win
news.impact: TeSlaa has made minimal impact on offense of late, finishing with 10 receiving yards or less in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options with plenty of explosive potential heading into a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught 1-of-2 targets for just ten yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He was targeted just twice and ended with just one catch for ten yards in this win over the Packers. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa held without a catch Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa had close to 100 yards last week, but he did not follow that up with a good performance in Week 5. He wasn't able to catch a single pass on Sunday, despite the fact that Detroit's offense was unstoppable in this win over the Cardinals. He is hard to trust from a fantasy perspective moving forward, as he is likely considered the fifth option on this offense at best.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa hauled in 4-of-8 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa approaches 100 yards on Sunday night
news.impact: TeSlaa had his biggest game of the season so far Sunday night, and has been showing off his big-play ability over the last two games. Over the past two Sundays, the second-year receiver has brought down seven passes for an average of 23.0 yards per catch. TeSlaa has certainly entered the flex conversation as a boom-or-bust option heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Cardinals.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-2 targets for 16 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Jahan Dotson hauls in two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Dotson logged the second most receptions by a Falcons' wide receiver in the game. Fantasy manages can leave Dotson off their roster heading into Week 10.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-5 targsts for 95 yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson hauls in 76 yard pass Sunday
news.impact: Dotson had a 76-yard reception with the Falcons recording 224 total yards of offense as a team. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 1-of-3 targets for only six yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson catches one short pass in Sunday's win
news.impact: Dotson has become a big-play wideout for the Falcons, as he had averaged nearly 28 yards on his seven total grabs over the previous three weeks headed into Sunday's game. He had also found the end zone twice in that stretch. However, as should be expected going forward, Dotson showed in this contest that he is a boom-or-bust fantasy option in the Falcons' passing attack.

news.body: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his five targets for 87 yards and one touchdown in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finds end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Dotson has made the most of his opportunities in the Atlanta passing offense of late, finishing with over 50 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout will look to offer head coach another stable pass-catching option moving forward, with a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss
news.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught his lone target for 13 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Lane's one target sets a new season low for the rookie. The passing attack was clearly not the same after losing both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Lane and the passing game to struggle if Huntley is unable to play in Week 9.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Lane has logged five targets in two straight games since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect the rookie to continue to get plenty of opportunities in the Ravens' passing attack.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens rookie wide receiver Ja'Kobi Lane caught four passes for 40 yards in Week 6.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane catches four passes in Week 6
news.impact: Lane has been out since Week 1 and was immediately involved in the offense. His receptions, yards and targets were all season highs. Rashod Bateman exited with a shoulder injury, and Lane could have a bigger role if he remains sidelined

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught four of six passes for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers snags four passes in win
news.impact: Meyers led the team in receptions and yards, while coming in second in targets. It was the veteran's second-best yardage total of the season, and he now has 65 yards or more in two of his last three games.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Meyers has been dealing with a pair of injuries lately, but neither of them are serious and he will be good to go for Thursday night's game. He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy option on a week-to-week basis even if active, however.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Meyers is on track to be good to go. He'll remain a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers finishes with a pair of receptions in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers actually led the Jaguars in targets on Sunday, as Trevor Lawrence and backup Quinn Ewers only put the ball in the air a combined 17 times. The Jaguars just did not need to sling it around to vanquish the Colts. Meyers has now caught two or fewer passes in 4-of-7 games so far this season, but he's still a significant piece of a high-powered offense.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards while losing three yards on his lone rushing attempt in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Jalen Coker records 29 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Coker caught four passes, but averaged just 7.3 yards per reception. Meanwhile, Darren Waller and Tetairoa McMillan combined for 146 receiving yards and two touchdowns. Coker continues to receive opportunities, but his production isn't enough to warrant a fantasy start in shallow leagues.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker caught six passes for 97 yards while seeing a season-high 13 targets in Week 6.
news.head: Jalen Coker has game-high 97 yards vs. Eagles
news.impact: Coker has at least nine targets in every game he has finished this season, forming an impressive tandem with second-year star Tetairoa McMillan. He had two touchdowns in Week 1 and has not scored since, but Carolina's passing attack has been impressive, and more will come in the future.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 2-of-4 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Jalen Nailor quiet Sunday
news.impact: Nailor remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 4-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jalen Nailor hits pay dirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Nailor found the end zone on a two-yard reception early in the fourth quarter to give the Raiders the lead. This marked his best game of the season, setting a new season-high in receptions and logging his first touchdown of the season. Nailor and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught two of his five targets for 14 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Nailor dismal in Week 7
news.impact: Nailor remains minimally involved in the Las Vegas passing attack, recording less than 30 receiving yards in each of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 1-of-4 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jalen Nailor quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Nailor wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the game and was only able to turn that into nine yards, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 10-of-12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase hauls in 10 passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Chase led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards in the win. Chase and Joe Burrow connected on a 47-yard touchdown to open the scoring. The 26-year-old has found the end zone in four straight games, and will look to continue that streak against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards. Chase has scored a touchdown in three straight games, giving him six overall this year. He will be a no-brainer WR1 in fantasy heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 8 for the Cincinnati Bengals according to Paul Dehner Jr.
news.head: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) off injury report for Week 8
news.impact: Chase is good to go after battling ankle issues earlier in the week, boosting a Cincinnati passing attack for Week 8.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase was seen in uniform for practice on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase (ankle) in uniform for practice Thursday
news.impact: Chase missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll need to continue to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in one of his two targets for 31 yards while also rushing once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jameson Williams sees two touches in Week 9 win
news.impact: Williams was bottled up by an underrated Miami defense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last six games. The wideout will look to return to his explosive form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in four of his six targets for a team-high 70 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 8 win over Vikings
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, registering one or more receiving touchdowns in each of his last three games. The wideout remains one of the more explosive offensive options for head coach Dan Campbell entering a juicy Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: The Lions gave Williams plenty of opportunities on Sunday, and he was able to capitalize on them. He caught two touchdowns and came close to hitting the 100 receiving yards mark, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He should continue to be viewed as a high-ceiling fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though his floor leaves something to be desired.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Williams only caught two passes on Sunday, but he was able to get into the end zone on both of them, which left him with a great fantasy total in this win over the Cardinals. He is expected to continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 7-of-10 targets for 51 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 'quiet' day Sunday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba was held to his worst performance of the season, but his seven receptions still helped fantasy managers in PPR leagues. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 6-of-11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba stellar in loss Monday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba was by far Seattle's leading receiver on Monday night, finishing with 92 more yards than their second highest contributor. He was also able to get into the end zone again and finished with a terrific fantasy total, which just adds to the insane pace that he has established over the first half of the season.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine of his 12 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauls in TD in Week 7 win
news.impact: Smith-Njigba's crazy production continues as he has at least 100 receiving yards in all but one of his seven games this season while adding eight touchdowns along the way. The star wideout will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Bears on Monday night.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues crazy start to season in loss to Denver
news.impact: JSN had himself a night against the Broncos' defense, though he got off to a quiet start. He has 717 yards through six games, a blistering pace of 2,031 receiving yards. He had almost 1,800 receiving yards last year, and if he can match or exceed that in 2026, it would be truly incredible.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught his only target for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9 with a concussion.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle suffers concussion in Week 9
news.impact: Waddle suffered the injury on a hit from Panthers safety Zakee Wheatley while attempting to make a reception downfield. He was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the game. Meanwhile, Courtland Sutton saw nine targets, while Pat Bryant caught four passes for 56 yards and a touchdown. Denver enters its Week 10 bye, giving Waddle additional time to clear the concussion protocol before facing the Raiders in Week 11. His availability remains uncertain.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Denver’s game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Sunday
news.impact: Waddle was hit hard while trying to make a leaping grab, and eventually found his way to the medical tent and locker room to be examined for a concussion. Tough break for the talented receiver.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) is questionable to return for the Denver Broncos Sunday according to Zac Stevens.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Waddle headed to the locker room after suffering a hard hit midway through the second quarter, hauling in his only target for 22 yards prior to exiting.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle scores touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Waddle scored from one yard out in the second quarter and caught the two-point conversion that cut Kansas City's lead to three in the fourth quarter. He also led Denver's wide receivers with six targets. The yardage wasn't there, but Waddle has separated himself from Courtland Sutton and Marvin Mims Jr. as the Broncos wide receiver to start in fantasy.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught two of four targets for 37 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy snags two passes in loss
news.impact: Jeudy was able to reignite some of the 2025 chemistry he had with Shedeur Sanders, but he was still fourth on the team in yards and receptions. He's not startable in any format.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy did not catch his lone target in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy held without catch Sunday
news.impact: Jeudy remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy catches four balls in Week 7 win
news.impact: Jeudy was quiet in the close win as he was held under 30 receiving yards for the fifth time in seven games this season. The veteran wideout will not be a recommended fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Cleveland Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy caught four passes for a team-high 69 yards in a Week 6 win against Baltimore.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy paces Cleveland in yards in Week 6
news.impact: Jeudy had his biggest game of the season so far, catching every target for a season-high in yardage. His name has been thrown around in trade rumors after the Browns' rookie wideouts started strong, but he has value as the team's WR3, even if he is not a reliable fantasy producer.

news.body: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 28 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jordan Addison finishes with 28 yards Monday night
news.impact: Addison has now finished with two or fewer receptions four times in seven games this season, as the inconsistent quarterback play in Minnesota this season has really limited his production. The speedy receiver possesses big-play ability, but if the Vikings don't figure things out at QB, Addison will remain a highly volatile fantasy option.

news.body: Jordan Addison hauled in three of his eight targets for 66 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Jordan Addison leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Addison has battled inconsistent involvement in the Minnesota passing attack, finishing with under 70 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Addison quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a low volume day for the entire Vikings passing attack. Addison remains a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) was officially a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) officially a full participant Wednesday
news.impact: Addison seems to be close to full health again after Minnesota's bye week last week. He was a full participant at practice on Wednesday and should be a full go for Week 7, although he doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future if Justin Jefferson (ankle) is in the lineup.

news.body: Jordan Watkins caught 4-of-4 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Jordan Watkins has big day Sunday
news.impact: Watkins was the player to take advantage of a depleted 49ers wide receiver room. He could hold WR3/flex appeal if Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel remain sidelined next week.

news.body: Jordan Watkins caught 3-of-6 targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Jordan Watkins eclipses 50 yards receiving Sunday
news.impact: With both Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans sidelined, Jordan Watkins led the way for 49ers'wide receivers on Sunday. The second-year pro is not likely to make much of a fantasy impact after the Week 8 bye.

news.body: Jordan Watkins caught his lone target for a 22-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: Jordan Watkins goes for 22 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Watkins was quiet in the win. The veteran receiver could see a larger role in Week 7 vs. the Falcons, with Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) not expected to play. Watkins has caught just three passes for 82 yards on the season.

news.body: Jordan Watkins caught 2-of-2 targets for 60 yards in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Jordan Watkins totals 60 yards Sunday
news.impact: Watkins saw more snaps with Mike Evans (rib) exiting early. He could see more opportunity if Evans misses more time.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson caught four of five targets for 30 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson snags four passes in NFL debut
news.impact: Tyson was second on the team in targets and receptions behind Chris Olave, great for an NFL debut and for coming off of an injury. He should only get better as he gets up to game speed and gets acclimated to the offense.

news.body: Saints WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with the Browns.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) officially active for Week 9
news.impact: Tyson was listed as questionable after being a limited participant in practice this week. Tyson is set to make his debut Sunday, but fantasy managers should not expect to much as the Saints will likely slowly work him into the lineup.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against Browns.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Tyson was limited in his return to practice this week. He will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson was officially limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Tyson continues to trend towards having a chance to be activated for Sunday's game against the Browns.

news.body: The Colts are trading wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs.
news.head: Josh Downs traded to Chiefs
news.impact: Downs had requested a trade and now officially gets his request as he joins Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City. The Chiefs were looking to address their wide receiver room and they do so here bringing in Downs. He should be the No. 2 target for Mahomes behind Rashee Rice.

news.body: Josh Downs caught three of his six targets for 24 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Josh Downs goes for 24 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Downs was quiet in what could be his final game with the Colts as trade rumors have popped up surrounding the slot receiver. If Downs ultimately ends up staying in Indy, he will go up against the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Josh Downs finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Downs was the only Colts player to get into the end zone Sunday, scoring his first touchdown of the season on a six-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the third quarter. Overall, Downs has mostly been a disappointment for fantasy managers this season. He has caught four or fewer passes in each of the last five games without reaching 50 yards in any of them.

news.body: Josh Downs will play for the Colts on Sunday against the Jaguars.
news.head: Josh Downs will play for Colts Sunday
news.impact: This comes after Downs reportedly requested a trade this week. He'll remain a borderline flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in only 3-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Justin Jefferson catches three passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Jefferson is one of the league's top talents at wide receiver. Still, the Vikings' inept quarterback play so far this season has turned the All-Pro into an inconsistent, boom-or-bust asset for fantasy managers. Jefferson is in the low-end WR2 discussion at present, but if the Vikings can figure things out at QB, he would fly back up the rankings.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in five of his nine targets for 33 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 8 loss to Lions
news.impact: Jefferson made the most of an otherwise forgettable performance, scoring a touchdown for the second time in four contests despite recording less than 45 receiving yards in three of his last four contests. The wideout has fallen victim to underwhelming quarterback play to this point ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Justin Jefferson caught 4-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Justin Jefferson quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a quiet afternoon for the entire Vikings passing attack. Jefferson will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Lions.

news.body: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The Vikings chose to limit Jefferson's workload at practice on Wednesday, though he is likely close to full health after the team's bye week last week. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 7, barring something unforeseen.

news.body: Kayshon Boutte caught 4-of-5 targets for 125 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Kayshon Boutte electric in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Boutte was fantastic on Sunday. He led the Texans in receiving yards, and he was also able to get into the end zone on two different occasions, which left him with a great fantasy total. He has been pretty forgettable throughout his time with the Texans thus far, but he may be emerging and could earn more opportunities for himself if he continues to play well.

news.body: Houston Texans wide receiver Kayshon Boutte caught one pass for 25 yards on two targets in the team's Week 7 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Kayshon Boutte takes backseat in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Boutte recorded a season-low offensive snap rate in Week 7: 31%. This is notable given Xavier Hutchinson's involvement and Marvin Harrison's expected role growth. Jaylin Noel did suffer an injury, but Boutte has yet to surpass 40 receiving yards in a game and has seen a decrease in snap rate in each of the last two weeks.

news.body: Kayshon Boutte caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Kayshon Boutte held to two receptions in Week 6
news.impact: Boutte continues to see limited targets in his first year in Houston, and will likely see even less with the addition of Marvin Harrison Jr. via trade. Fantasy managers should only view Boutte as an option in deeper formats.

news.body: Kayshon Boutte caught 3-of-5 targets for 38 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Kayshon Boutte catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Boutte remains off the fantasy radar in his current role, especially with the Texans trading for Marvin Harrison Jr.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for long touchdown in loss
news.impact: Concepcion had a 64-yard score where he took a deep pass from Shedeur Sanders to the house. He did have a non-contact injury and hobbled off the field, but he came back in and caught his touchdown afterwards. Managers will need to monitor his status in practice this week to see if it pops up.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. totals 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Concepcion was quiet compared to last week when he exploded for 129 yards. He'll remain a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught eight of his 10 targets for 129 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for eight catches, 129 yards in Week 7
news.impact: The rookie easily turned in his best game as a pro as he dominated the Titans in the close win. Concepcion came into the game with just 186 receiving yards on the year and came close to doubling that total while leading the Browns in all receiving categories against Tennessee. He will be a WR3 heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie is currently dealing with a pair of injuries and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. They could affect his availability or workload for Week 7, but we won't know more until later on in the week.

news.body: The Colts are trading WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a 2027 sixth-round pick
news.head: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
news.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught four of his eight targets for 26 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Allen led the team with his eight targets but wasn't able to do much with the opportunities. The veteran wideout has emerged as one of Daniel Jones' favorite targets this season, catching 40 passes for 351 yards and one touchdown in eight games. Allen will be a flex option in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Keenan Allen was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Keenan Allen returns to practice on Thursday
news.impact: Allen got a rest day to begin the week on Wednesday. He remains a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught all seven of his targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Keenan Allen grabs seven passes in Sunday's loss
news.impact: Allen led all players in this contest in receptions and receiving yards, as the 34-year-old veteran continues to show he can still make plays. Allen has averaged just shy of six grabs and 60 yards over his last five games, but with trade rumors swirling around the Colts, his situation may soon change.

news.body: The Cardinals placed WR Kendrick Bourne on injured reserve.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Bourne suffered a broken tibia that will end his season.

news.body: Cardinals WR Kendrick Bourne’s ankle injury could end his season.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne (ankle) could be out for season
news.impact: Bourne had a non-contact injury with 21 seconds left in the first half of Sunday's game against the Cowboys. He is still undergoing tests.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne caught one of his two targets for 29 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne quiet in Week 8 win
news.impact: Bourne exited with a right ankle sprain in Sunday's win, finishing with less than six targets for the first time in four contests. The wideout's status will need to be monitored throughout the week ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne caught three of six targets for nine yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne Held to Nine Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Bourne saw six targets but averaged just three yards per reception. Even with Jacoby Brissett attempting 48 passes, Bourne couldn't turn the volume into meaningful production. There isn't enough upside here to trust him in fantasy leagues.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Keon Coleman finishes with three receptions Monday night
news.impact: Coleman has had a few strong games this season. He even had a stretch of three straight weeks with a touchdown. Since then, Coleman has managed only four receptions for 21 yards over the last two games. The third-year receiver is just unreliable from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Keon Coleman held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman saw a major drop off from his six targets last week. With his inconsistent usage this season, fantasy managers should look elsewhere against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 4-of-6 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Keon Coleman leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Coleman stepped up with DJ Moore (shoulder) sidelined for the Bills on Sunday. He led the team with 59 receiving yards against the Raiders, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a nice fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started in most league formats if Moore has to miss additional time beyond this game.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard touchdown in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Keon Coleman catches TD in Week 5
news.impact: Coleman made his only catch count as he hauled in Josh Allen's lone touchdown pass late in the third quarter. It was still a disappointing game for Coleman, who was expected to see a larger target share with DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive. Coleman will be on the flex radar in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Raiders if Moore isn't ready to return to the field.

news.body: Khalil Shakir brought down all four of his targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Khalil Shakir leads Bills in receiving Monday night
news.impact: Shakir tied for the team lead in catches and topped the Bills in receiving yards Monday night. Shakir has now caught four or more passes in four of the last five games, averaging 4.6 receptions and 63.6 yards per game in that span.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-6 targets for 64 yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in five passes in Week 8 win
news.impact: Shakir has seen back-to-back games with at least six targets and has logged at least four receptions in each of those games. Shakir and the Bills will take on a tough Vikings' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Khalil Shakir finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Shakir was a bit disappointing as far as yardage goes on Sunday, but he made up for that by scoring one of Buffalo's touchdowns through the air. Still, he isn't a reliable fantasy option at this point, and fantasy managers should be especially wary about starting him whenever DJ Moore (shoulder) is back in the lineup for Buffalo.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught all three of his targets for 80 yards in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Khalil Shakir goes for 80 yards in Week 5 win
news.impact: Shakir led the Bills in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 57-yard catch early in overtime. Shakir now has 18 catches for 256 yards and no touchdowns through his team's first five games. He will be a flex option in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield had two catches for 20 yards in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield snags two catches in win
news.impact: Mumpfield had minimal involvement in Sunday’s victory, but if Puka Nacua misses time with a knee injury, Mumpfield will be a popular waiver wire add and the next man up in the Rams' wide receiver room. He holds flex value in Week 10 against the Cardinals if Nacua is unable to play.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught one of his two targets for 15 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield quiet in Week 7
news.impact: Mumpfield has struggled to make an impact in the Los Angeles passing attack, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in seven of eight contests. The wideout cannot be trusted as a reliable pass-catching option in any format ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: It looks like Mumpfield's shoulder injury is nothing serious, as he was able to log a full practice session to start the week on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 5.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught 1-of-3 targets for seven yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Mumpfield wasn't able to get much going on Sunday, finishing with just one catch for seven yards in a win over the Eagles. He isn't expected to play a big role for the Rams moving forward now that Puka Nacua is healthy and back in the lineup.

news.body: Kyle Williams failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Kyle Williams held catchless in loss Sunday
news.impact: Williams wasn't able to connect with Drake Maye on either of his two targets, leaving him with a catchless game on Sunday. He has big-play potential on a week-to-week basis, but those are few and far between enough to consider him a non-factor for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught his only target for a 43-yard bomb touchdown in the Patriots' win 24-19 over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Kyle Williams snags bomb touchdown in win
news.impact: Williams was quiet for the majority of the game, but came away with what ended up being a huge grab that kickstarted the Patriots' offense. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at this point and is best left on waivers.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught all three of his targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Raiders.
news.head: Kyle Williams finds the end zone in Week 5 win
news.impact: Williams hauls in a 34-yard pass from Drake Maye early in the third quarter for his first touchdown of the season. This was Williams first contest of the season in which he logged more than one reception. Williams and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught 1-of-3 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Kyle Williams held to one catch Sunday
news.impact: The young wideout got on the field on Sunday and was able to haul in one 34-yard pass against the Jaguars, but he wasn't able to do anything else in the team's blowout loss. It's nice to see him actually on the field for New England, but he doesn't project to have any fantasy value for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Ladd McConkey did not log a stat in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans after leaving the game early with a back issue.
news.head: Ladd McConkey suffers back injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: McConkey's frustrating season continued on Sunday. He suffered a back injury of some kind during pregame warmups and left the game in the first quarter before logging even a single stat. It remains to be seen if he will miss any time, but fantasy managers shouldn't count on him being relevant anytime soon either way.

news.body: Ladd McConkey caught 4-of-5 targets for 86 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Ladd McConkey leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McConkey had a solid game on the stat sheet on Sunday, leading the team with 84 yards in a loss to the Rams. That was heavily propped up by a 50+ yard catch he had on a tipped deep shot at the end of the first half, however, so he wasn't actually a consistent contributor throughout the course of the game. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high trust in starting him on a weekly basis, especially with how bad this offense still looks for the Chargers.

news.body: Ladd McConkey is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Rams.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: McConkey has been able to clear the concussion protocol. It has been a rough season injury wise for him. He remains a WR2 when he is healthy.

news.body: Ladd McConkey taken out of Sunday's game early due to a concussion.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (concussion) knocked out of Sunday's game
news.impact: The setbacks just continue for McConkey this season. He worked through a foot injury at practice this week. Now, he'll enter the league's concussion protocol after exiting Sunday's game against the Chiefs in the second quarter. McConkey made just one reception for 17 yards prior to leaving.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught just 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell catches just one pass Sunday
news.impact: For the second consecutive week, Treadwell saw just two passes thrown his way. Over those two games, the veteran receiver has only three receptions for 37 yards. At the moment, Treadwell doesn't really register on the fantasy radar. That could change if the Colts, as expected, trade away some offensive pieces.
