news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell brings in two passes in loss
news.impact: Treadwell continued his trend of catching fewer than 50% of his targets. He's not a great option for fantasy in any format, failing to produce anything even in a depleted pass-catching room.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of eight targets for 34 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell sees eight targets in Week 5
news.impact: Treadwell had the second most targets on the team, behind the nine of Tyler Warren and Keenan Allen. However, he failed to convert on most of those attempts, although sometimes he was the closest target on throwaway throws by QB Daniel Jones, so the targets are slightly inflated. Still, he's not going to be doing much for fantasy, so it's best to leave him on waivers.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught 5-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Colts win over the Commanders.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
news.impact: Treadwell saw an increase in playing time with the Colts dealing with injuries to Alec Pierce and Keenan Allen. Fantasy managers should expect this to be an outlier, as Treadwell's playing time will diminish once Allen and Pierce return.

news.body: Mack Hollins caught 3-of-6 targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Mack Hollins scores once in return game Sunday
news.impact: Sunday was Hollins' first game back after missing an extended period of time with a calf issue. He played pretty well, racking up 36 yards and a touchdown in this loss to the Packers. He isn't likely to be a great fantasy option moving forward, however, especially if A.J. Brown (knee) makes his return to the lineup soon.

news.body: Mack Hollins (calf) is active for Week 9 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: Mack Hollins (calf) active for Week 9
news.impact: Hollins will take the field after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, boosting a New England wideout group that will be missing No. 1 option A.J. Brown against the Packers.

news.body: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said they'll see how Mack Hollins feels Saturday and make a decision on his status.
news.head: Mack Hollins (calf) to have decision made on status Saturday
news.impact: Hollins will need to be activated from injured reserve by Saturday if he is good to go.

news.body: Mack Hollins (calf) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Mack Hollins (calf) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Hollins made his return to practice on Wednesday as a limited participant. He has been on injured reserve for a while due to a calf issue, but it looks like he will be back in the lineup very soon. He isn't likely to have a lot of individual fantasy value moving forward, but his eventual return should help QB Drake Maye substantially.

news.body: Makai Lemon hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 61 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Makai Lemon leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a solid showing on Sunday. He led the team with 61 receiving yards over the course of the day, though his fantasy total remained limited since he didn't get into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a decent option in PPR leagues for the foreseeable future, even if his week-to-week upside isn't great.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Makai Lemon draws nine targets in Week 8
news.impact: Lemon led the Eagles in all receiving categories with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both out. The rookie has been productive over his past two contests, going for 124 yards and a touchdown over that span. He will be a flex option in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 7-of-8 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Makai Lemon plays well in loss Monday
news.impact: The rookie finally had a high-production game, finishing with the most receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns out of anyone on the team on Monday night. This performance was a good sign that he's not dead in the water after a slow start to the season, but he's unlikely to keep up at this pace when DeVonta Smith (hamstring) makes his return to the lineup.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon caught three passes on six targets for 19 yards in Week 6 against Carolina.
news.head: Makai Lemon inefficient on six targets in Week 6
news.impact: Lemon had a season-high 43 yards in Week 5 but recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. With 4.5 yards per target through six games, Lemon has started slowly in his rookie year. With a backup quarterback taking over, the Eagles' offense could continue to struggle.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malachi Fields racks up 40 yards Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was a solid contributor for New York on Sunday, finishing with 40 yards in a win over the Eagles. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to evolve into a trustworthy fantasy asset anytime soon, however.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
news.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-8 targets for 19 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malachi Fields sees eight targets Sunday
news.impact: Fields was second among Giants wide receivers in targets. It didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Malachi Fields bottled up in Week 5
news.impact: Fields has made minimal impact in the New York passing attack to begin the season, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in four of five contests. The pass-catcher remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest with the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 5-of-8 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malik Nabers underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: Nabers didn't have a great game to his standards on Sunday. He finished with under 50 yards in this win over the Eagles, and he wasn't able to bring in a nice touchdown that would've been the highlight play of the day. He should bounce back and return to form in the very near future, however.

news.body: Malik Nabers was seen catching passes during a walkthrough session for the New York Giants Friday.
news.head: Malik Nabers catching passes Friday
news.impact: Nabers has dealt with unknown issues throughout the practice week for head coach John Harbaugh, but the talented wideout seems poised to take the field barring any serious setbacks ahead of Sunday’s divisional matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles.

news.body: Malik Nabers was seen working off to the side with trainers on Thursday.
news.head: Malik Nabers works off to side with trainers during practice Thursday
news.impact: It is unclear what Nabers is dealing with. He will need to be monitored when the injury report for Thursday is released.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 7-of-9 targets for 111 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malik Nabers totals 111 yards Sunday
news.impact: Despite the quarterback change, Nabers production remained just as dominant. He remains a WR1 moving forward.

news.body: Malik Washington caught two of his three targets for 21 yards while also rushing once for no gain in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
news.head: Malik Washington quiet in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Washington has cooled off in the Miami offense of late, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains another inconsistent option as part of an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Malik Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Washington snags touchdown in loss to Patriots
news.impact: Washington had a score in the second quarter to put the Dolphins up by 10, led the team in receptions, and tied for the lead in targets. He's developed into a usable PPR asset this season and should have some utility next week against the Lions' secondary.

news.body: Malik Washington is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Malik Washington (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Washington will remain in the WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Malik Washington was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Malik Washington (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Washington is on the injury report with a knee issue. He'll remain on the WR3 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 2-of-3 targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Houston's offense was on a roll on Sunday, but Harrison wasn't able to take part in that. He finished with just 20 yards in the teams' win over the Chargers, and it looks like there are several other wideouts on the team ahead of him in the pecking order at this point. He shouldn't be rostered in most league formats at this point.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 1-of-4 targets for six yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: For fantasy managers desperate enough to start Harrison, fortunately his lone catch was in the end zone. He remains in the WR4/WR5 range.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 34 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. hauls in three passes in Week 6
news.impact: Harrison was making his debut for Houston and was figured to only factor into a handful of plays. Despite that, his three receptions tie a season high and the Texans are clearly high on the 24-year-old. Harrison and the Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. (trade) will be available to play in Week 6, according to HC DeMeco Ryans.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. will play Week 6
news.impact: Houston recently made a trade to acquire Harrison from the Cardinals, and he is already going to be ready to play in time for Sunday's game against the Jaguars. He is going to be on a snap count to some degree, so fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him in his first game as a Texan this week, however.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in all of his team-leading 10 targets for 164 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Matthew Golden reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Golden has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 75 receiving yards in four of his last five contests. The wideout remains one of the more impactful offensive options to this point in the Green Bay offense entering a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Matthew Golden caught 7-of-13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Golden was questionable with shoulder and foot injuries leading into Thursday's game. He didn't seem very bothered by either, however. The first-round selection from 2025 continued his breakout season, setting a new career high with seven receptions against the Panthers' beat-up secondary. Golden also went over 75 yards for the fifth time in eight games this season.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is active for the Packers' game against the Panthers on Thursday night.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) active for TNF against Carolina
news.impact: Golden was initially questionable coming into the contest, but there was optimism that he would play. That turned out to be the case, and he will suit up against the Panthers. He should be started against a defense lacking its top two corners.

news.body: Matthew Golden is “trending toward playing” in Week 8 against the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) trending towards playing Thursday
news.impact: Golden was listed as questionable after getting in a limited practice in the Packers lone actual practice session. He should be good to go.

news.body: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr said he hopes to be back after the bye week and has started running.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) hopeful to return in Week 10
news.impact: Pittman said the injury began as plantar fasciitis but turned into something else with his foot. He was never expected to require surgery.

news.body: The Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman on injured reserve.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) placed on IR
news.impact: Pittman will miss at least the next four weeks. Roman Wilson and Germie Bernard should both step into bigger roles in the Steelers wide receiver room.

news.body: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Michael Pittman re-aggravated his foot injury and will miss multiple weeks.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) expected to miss multiple weeks
news.impact: It appears Pittman could be placed on injured reserve. He was seen on a scooter on Wednesday. Roman Wilson will continue to see more opportunity as the Steelers WR2, while Germie Bernard will see more opportunity behind him.

news.body: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran is now dealing with a foot injury of some kind. He was officially limited because of it on Wednesday, but he was also seen moving around on a scooter in the locker room, which makes it seem like a long-shot that he will play this week. If he's sidelined, fantasy managers should look for Roman Wilson to continue to benefit from his absence for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Mike Evans (Achilles) is considered week-to-week at this point.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) considered week-to-week
news.impact: Evans is still recovering from an Achilles injury, and the team has no concrete timetable for his return beyond considering him week-to-week at this point. That makes him unlikely to play in Week 10, which would lead to more fantasy value for Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) and Keenan Allen for the time being.

news.body: Mike Evans (Achilles) won't take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Evans is still recovering from an Achilles issue and is not going to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like he's trending towards missing another game because of it in Week 10, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said he does not expect Mike Evans to return to practice this week.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) not expected to practice this week
news.impact: Evans is likely to remain sidelined in Week 10 against the Cowboys. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Mike Evans (achilles) has been ruled out for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
news.head: Mike Evans (achilles) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Evans will not suit up after struggling to reach the practice field this week, lining up Demarcus Robinson (ankle) and Brandin Cooks to lead a shorthanded wideout group against the Raiders for head coach Kyle Shanahan Sunday.

news.body: Nico Collins caught four passes for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Nico Collins finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout had a solid game on Sunday. He caught four passes for 55 yards and was able to get into the end zone on one of them, which left him with a good fantasy total in this matchup. Fantasy managers should feel solid about his value moving forward, though he may continue to be a bit volatile on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
news.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 74 yards in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville. Collins also added five rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Nico Collins hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
news.impact: Collins saw his production drop with C.J. Stroud spreading the ball around to 10 different pass catchers. He will look to bounce back against a weak Giants' secondary in Week 7.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 5-of-7 targets for 56 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Nico Collins sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge afternoon for Collins as Houston controlled the entire game. He will remain a WR1 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Omar Cooper Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (undisclosed) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: It is still a positive sign that Cooper was able to practice in some capacity. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 8-of-11 targets for 58 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. hauls in eight passes in Week 9
news.impact: Cooper led the Jets' pass catchers in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss. This was a much needed bounce back performance after the rookie failed to record a target against the Raiders a week ago. Cooper and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. did not record a target in a Week 8 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. not targeted in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Cooper had logged back-to-back 100-yard performances, but was not a factor at all against Las Vegas. Adonai Mitchell saw an increase in playing time and that clearly had an impact on Cooper's playing time. Cooper and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5-of-5 targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Cooper has put together back-to-back 100 yard performances for the Jets. He did the bulk of his work on receptions of 52 and 60-yards. Fantasy managers should view him as a strong option heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Raiders.

news.body: Parker Washington caught two of seven targets for 61 yards and a score in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win over Ravens
news.impact: Almost all of Washington's fantasy points came on a long 50-yard catch-and-run touchdown in the first half. He failed to bring in anything else after that and suffered some drops as well. It wasn't the greatest game for the talented WR, but it certainly could have been much worse.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-2 targets for 16 yards and gained 10 yards on one carry in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Parker Washington catches just one pass in Week 8
news.impact: This was not the game fantasy managers expected from Washington on Sunday, but the Jaguars just didn't need to throw the ball much in order to blow out the struggling Colts. Washington's stat lines have been all over the place the last few games, but he is still the top receiving option on a high-powered offense that spreads the ball around.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

news.body: Parker Washington brought down 6-of-9 targets for 124 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Parker Washington rebounds with huge performance in Week 5
news.impact: Washington eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season on Sunday, doubling his touchdown total for the season in the process. He looked every bit the part of a dynamic WR1 on Sunday. However, the Jaguars have a plethora of talented pass catchers, and QB Trevor Lawrence does tend to spread the ball around. Still, Washington is a potent fantasy option.

news.body: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) will not land on injured reserve due to roster logistics, but he is still expected to be sidelined for around 4-6 weeks
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) won't land on IR, still out for extended time
news.impact: The Rams are not going to place Nacua on injured reserve, not because he will be back sooner than expected, but rather just as a roster management tactic. This is significant for fantasy managers, as he may not be eligible for an IR slot in many league formats as a result of this. That will make him significantly harder to roster for the 4-6 weeks that he's expected to be out.

news.body: ESPN’s Dan Graziano reports Puka Nacua will not miss the rest of the regular season.
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) hopeful to return by Week 14 or 15
news.impact: Graziano notes that Rams sources “were very adamant that Nacua’s injury isn’t season-ending and that they hope to get him back around that Week 14, Week 15 time.” Nacua has not been placed on injured reserve yet, but it remains a possibility.

news.body: Puka Nacua (knee, toe) is expected to be placed on IR with injuries to his MCL, PCL, and turf toe according ot HC Sean McVay.
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee, toe) expected to go on IR with litany of injuries
news.impact: While it was known Puka was battling through some injuries, it wasn't clear that it was this bad. With Davante Adams already out and on IR, and Puka likely to follow, the Rams' season is going downhill fast. Expect them to make some moves at WR before the trade deadline.

news.body: Puka Nacua had 14 receptions for 150 yards and one touchdown in Sunday's win over the Commanders. He added two rushes for 20 yards.
news.head: Puka Nacua torches Commanders for 170 all-purpose yards and touchdown
news.impact: Nacua accounted for 66% of quarterback Matthew Stafford’s passing yardage in the win. Unfortunately, Nacua suffered a knee injury late in the game, so his status for Week 10 against the Cardinals is uncertain, and his practice reports throughout the week should be monitored. If he is able to play in Week 10, he will be in WR1 overall conversation.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught 1-of-4 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Quentin Johnston hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Johnston was able to break Los Angeles' no-touchdown streak by taking a short catch 58 yards to the house on Sunday. He finished as the team's leading receiver as a result, but since he had no catches outside of that, his fantasy total remained mediocre. He is not expected to be a worthwhile asset moving forward, though he could see more work if Ladd McConkey (back) has to miss time.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught four passes for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Quentin Johnston racks up 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Johnston didn't have a great game on Sunday. He was a solid contributor with four catches for 37 yards, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a disappointing fantasy total. He should not be started for the foreseeable future, especially with how bad this Los Angeles offense still looks.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught one pass for 57 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Quentin Johnston Makes 57-Yard Catch in Week 6
news.impact: Johnston's lone reception accounted for more than a quarter of Justin Herbert's 204 passing yards. The big play salvaged his fantasy day, but one reception isn't sustainable production. Johnston remains a volatile option until the Chargers can get him more consistent volume on a weekly basis.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Johnston was dealing with a chest injury at practice throughout the week, but it seems to be nothing more than a minor issue, as he is off of the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will play on Sunday and should see more work than usual with Tre' Harris (hamstring) set to be sidelined for the Chargers.

news.body: Rashee Rice caught 5-of-7 targets for 49 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Rashee Rice hauls in five passes in Week 9
news.impact: Rice was limited during the week ahead of this game with knee and hamstring injures, but played well and did the most of his opportunities. Rice and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

news.body: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rice is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He should still be available to play in Week 9, but we won't get an official injury decision for him until later on in the week.

news.body: Rashee Rice caught seven of eight targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Rashee Rice scores touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Rice led Kansas City with eight targets and seven receptions. He also caught an 11-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Rice averaged just 7.6 yards per reception, but that's secondary to the usage. He remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options.

news.body: Rashee Rice will return for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.impact: Rice will return for a big divisional matchup against Denver. He should return to being a borderline WR1/WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught one of two targets for six yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Rashod Bateman hauls in short pass in loss
news.impact: Bateman has two catches in as many weeks, and he's fallen out of relevance for fantasy. Leave him on waivers until he shows some sort of value.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught 1-of-3 targets for 22 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Rashod Bateman hauls in one pass in Week 8
news.impact: Bateman led the team in receiving yards, but there was not much going for any of the Ravens' pass catchers in Week 8. Fantasy managers should expect Bateman to struggle again if Tyler Huntley (toe) is unable to play in Week 9.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-4 targets for 33 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Rashod Bateman hauls in two passes in Week 7
news.impact: Bateman has seen his role decrease over the last two weeks with the return of Ja'Kobi Lane to the lineup. Bateman is a bench stash at best right now for fantasy managers heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Bills.

news.body: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Bateman will be good to go for Sunday's game after being limited by a shoulder issue earlier in the week. He isn't expected to be a trustworthy fantasy option in this game, however, though his ceiling will be raised considerably if QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is cleared to play ahead of game time.

news.body: Reggie Virgil was carted off after colliding with a goalpost in Arizona’s Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Reggie Virgil carted off field Sunday
news.impact: Virgil was down after colliding into the goal post. There should be an update on his status when available.

news.body: Reggie Virgil failed to catch either of his two targets in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Dallas Cowboys in Week 8.
news.head: Reggie Virgil sees two targets in Week 8
news.impact: Virgil has seen minimal involvement in the Arizona offense to this point, recording targets in two of his four contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: The Arizona Cardinals have selected WR Reggie Virgil with the No. 143 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.head: Reggie Virgil selected No. 143 by Arizona Cardinals
news.impact: The Arizona Cardinals continue to improve their offense, adding Reggie Virgil after drafting Jeremiyah Love and Carson Beck. Virgil should compete with Kendrick Bourne for the No. 3 wide receiver spot as a rookie.

news.body: Texas Tech WR Reggie Virgil visited the Cardinals on Monday.
news.head: Reggie Virgil visits Cardinals
news.impact: Virgil also has several private workouts scheduled. He caught 57 passes for 705 yards and six touchdowns in his one season at Texas Tech. Arizona will likely seek more help at the wide receiver position to go along with Marvin Harrison Jr. and Michael Wilson.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught four of his seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Rome Odunze finds the end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Odunze found the end zone for the first time all year on a nine-yard pass from Caleb Williams in the first quarter. The veteran wideout has now caught 32 passes for 528 yards in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.

news.body: Rome Odunze secured 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes Thursday night
news.impact: Odunze seems to still be third in the pecking order of Bears pass catchers behind TE Colston Loveland and fellow wideout Luther Burden. Still, Odunze turned in a solid effort Thursday night. Over the last two games with QB Caleb Williams back at the helm of the offense, Odunze has come up with 7-of-9 targets for 108 yards. The third-year pro has 24 receptions with an average of 15.9 yards per catch through seven games.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his three targets for 53 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy goes for 53 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Flournoy was quiet despite the Cowboys playing without George Pickens (hamstring) in the contest. The veteran wideout has been a solid WR3 for Dallas this season, catching 32 passes for 395 yards and two touchdowns in nine games. He will be on the flex radar against the 49ers in Week 10 if Pickens is unable to suit up.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught three of his four targets for 38 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for three yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring a touchdown in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains a touchdown dependent option in all formats ahead of a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught four passes for 70 yards in Monday's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy racks up 70 yards in win Monday
news.impact: Flournoy wasn't heavily targeted on Monday night, but he was able to make the most out of his four opportunities by turning them into four catches for 70 total yards. He isn't fantasy relevant at this point, but he is currently a strong contributor for the Cowboys in real life and worth keeping an eye on if someone ahead of him on the depth chart suffers an injury.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught seven of his nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Flournoy turned in a solid game while operating as the Cowboys' No. 3 receiver. He caught Dak Prescott's lone touchdown on a six-yard pass with 44 seconds left in the contest. Flournoy now has 23 catches for 234 yards and one touchdown through six contests this year. He will be a decent flex in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Savion Williams caught three of his four targets for 25 yards and one touchdown while also rushing three times for 13 yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Savion Williams scores touchdown in Week 9 win
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact in the Green Bay offense, logging less than 60 offensive yards in each of his four contests. the wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Savion Williams caught 1-of-2 targets for just five yards, adding an 18-yard run in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Savion Williams does little with two touches in Week 8
news.impact: Williams hauled in four and three passes, respectively, over the previous two games heading into Thursday night. He is a factor for the Packers' offense, but he's well behind fellow wide receivers Matthew Golden and Christian Watson, as well as TE Tucker Kraft, in the pecking order for targets from QB Jordan Love. Workhorse RB Josh Jacobs is back in the fold as well. Williams has playmaking potential, but the volume just isn't there right now for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) will play Sunday
news.impact: Williams is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite managing an ankle injury earlier in the week. He isn't expected to see a lot of work against the Lions, however, though his workload will increase if Bo Melton (back) is ruled out ahead of game time.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) limited Wednesday
news.impact: Williams was unable to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he's still dealing with a nagging ankle issue. He was able to play through it last week, however, which suggests that he will do the same again this week.

news.body: Stefon Diggs had three catches for 51 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Stefon Diggs has 51 yards in loss
news.impact: Diggs' 51 yards is his second-highest yardage total of the season. Despite Terry McLaurin's season-ending injury, Diggs' role has remained the same. He will fall in the WR3 range for Thursday's game against the Giants.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught three of his six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Stefon Diggs finds the end zone in Week 8 win
news.impact: Diggs hauled in an eight-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the second quarter. The veteran wideout has been busy in the red zone this season, catching five touchdowns despite only posting 27 receptions in six games. He will be a solid flex option in fantasy in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Stefon Diggs is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Diggs will be a WR3 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. He was held out of Wednesday's practice due to a pair of issues, but neither of them are considered serious at this point. He remains a safe flex option in most league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tank Dell hauled in 4-of-9 targets for 105 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Tank Dell hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Dell looked fantastic on Sunday. He logged over 100 receiving yards in this win over the Chargers and was also able to get into the end zone once, which left him with a great fantasy total. If he continues to see this much work, he will soon be a great depth piece in most fantasy leagues, though his week-to-week outlook may be tricky with how many viable receiving options Houston has right now.

news.body: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said WR Tank Dell’s snap will go up.
news.head: Tank Dell expected to see increase in snaps
news.impact: Ryans clarified that it isn't because Jaylin Noel is out but because the natural progression of Dell working his way back. He remains a risky start for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tank Dell caught his lone target for 43 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Tank Dell hauls in big catch Sunday
news.impact: Dell was making his much anticipated return for the first time in two years. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

news.body: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Tank Dell (knee) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Dell was considered questionable to play but will suit up for the first time since December 2024. Fantasy managers should expect Dell to have limited fantasy value right now.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 32 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Tee Higgins hits pay dirt twice in Week 9 win
news.impact: Higgins did not see a ton of targets Sunday, but made the most of his opportunities by hauling in two touchdowns. Higgins has found the end zone in three straight games, including back-to-back multi-touchdown performances. Higgins and the Bengals will look to continue that momentum against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 10 of his 11 targets for 155 yards and two touchdowns in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Tee Higgins scores twice in Week 8 win
news.impact: Higgins had a huge game in the high-scoring win. He hauled in touchdown passes of 17 and 18 yards from Joe Burrow, giving him four on the season. Higgins has been on fire of late, reaching at least 148 receiving yards in three of his past four games. He will be a WR1 in Week 9 vs. Atlanta.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 6-of-7 targets for 148 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tee Higgins accounts for 148 yards in Week 7 win
news.impact: Higgins gave the Bengals the lead in the third quarter on a 13-yard touchdown reception. This was a much needed bounce back performance after struggling in Week 5 against Miami. Higgins will look to build on this performance in Week 8 against the Titans.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 2-of-4 targets for just 22 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Tee Higgins disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was dealing with several different injuries at practice throughout the week, but the team cleared him to play for Sunday's game. He didn't end up producing well, finishing with just 22 scoreless yards on two catches in a win over the Dolphins. He should have a good opportunity to get healthy during Cincinnati's bye week this week, however, so fantasy managers should expect him to bounce back after that.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: McMillan caught a four-yard touchdown with just over three minutes remaining to pull Carolina within five points. He finished second on the Panthers in receiving yards behind Darren Waller, who saw 10 targets compared to McMillan's six. The touchdown helped, but Waller commanded more opportunities against Denver. McMillan remains a starting option in fantasy leagues heading into Week 10.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan brought down 6-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan catches six passes in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Fantasy managers in PPR formats were certainly okay with McMillan's performance in this one. The volume was there, but the Packers did a great job of limiting the second-year star's yardage. McMillan has now caught 30 passes over his last four games and is averaging exactly six per contest for the season. However, he scored both of his touchdowns in Week 4 against the Lions. He remains a high-end WR2 in most formats.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 40 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan catches four passes in loss
news.impact: McMillan was largely held in check all day by the Tampa defense, as was the rest of the Carolina offense. It wasn't a great showing by the young receiver, but it didn't sink your week. He will look to improve on those numbers against the Packers on TNF.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan caught six passes for 86 yards in a Week 6 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan gains 86 yards in Week 6 win
news.impact: McMillan has 75+ yards and 8+ targets in four of five games to start the season, a reliable floor in what has been a potent Carolina passing offense. He has not caught a touchdown yet with wide receiver Jalen Coker in the lineup, but McMillan's large frame and target rate indicate more could come in the future after scoring seven as a rookie.

news.body: Tre' Harris caught 3-of-7 targets for just six yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Tre' Harris held to six yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Harris saw the most targets out of anybody on the team on Sunday, but he finished with just six yards over the course of the game, so he didn't at all capitalize on his opportunities. He should not be rostered in most league formats at this point.

news.body: Tre' Harris caught three passes for 31 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tre' Harris catches three passes in loss Sunday
news.impact: Harris was able to do his job on Sunday, catching all three of his targets for a solid gain over the course of the game. He didn't have any impressive stats for fantasy purposes, however, and should not be rostered in most league formats moving forward.

news.body: Tre' Harris is good to go for Sunday's game against the Rams.
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.impact: Harris is good to go after the bye week. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Tre' Harris (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Harris is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a hamstring injury right now and will have to miss some time while he recovers. Look for Quentin Johnston to be one of the primary beneficiaries of his absence.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 55 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Tre Tucker totals 55 yards Sunday
news.impact: The eight targets Tucker saw tied the team-high. He will remain a volatile WR3 heading into next week against the Seahawks.

news.body: Tre Tucker did not record a reception on his lone target in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Tre Tucker held without a catch in Week 8 win
news.impact: Tucker's one target marks a new season low for the 25-year-old. Jalen Nailor was the only wide receiver on the roster that logged a catch in the high-scoring affair with the Jets. Tucker and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Tre Tucker hauled in five of his team-high 12 targets for 103 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tre Tucker leads pass-catchers in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Tucker has been dynamic in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, recording over 90 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in each of the last two contests. The wideout offers head coach Klint Kubiak one of the more impactful options in the Las Vegas passing attack to this point, with a Week 8 matchup against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Tre Tucker stellar in loss Sunday
news.impact: Tucker had a stellar performance on Sunday. He led the team with 97 yards over the course of the afternoon and he was also able to get into the end zone on two occasions, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. Fantasy managers should consider picking him up if he's available on the waiver wire, as the team may very well try to get him more involved on a week-to-week basis after this game.

news.body: Tutu Atwell had two catches for 16 yards in Sunday’s win against the Commanders.
news.head: Tutu Atwell has two catches in win
news.impact: Atwell hasn’t been very involved in the Rams offense since they lost wide receiver Davante Adams. However, if Puka Nacua (knee) misses time, Atwell could hold desperation flex value in Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 2-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tutu Atwell racks up 54 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wideout was able to leave his mark on Sunday's game. He racked up 54 yards on just two catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone on either of them. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high hopes for him moving forward.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 1-of-2 targets for 19 yards in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Tutu Atwell held to one catch Monday
news.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to capitalize on the absence of Puka Nacua (hip) on Monday night, hauling in just one pass over the course of the night. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tutu Atwell will be inactive against the Niners on Thursday.
news.head: Tutu Atwell inactive against Niners
news.impact: Atwell was recently traded to the Rams from Miami, joining his former team. He will need to wait another week to see the field.

news.body: Tyreek Hill's agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill is expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks.
news.head: Tyreek Hill (knee) expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks
news.impact: Hill will be an option for a team that doesn't land a wide receiver ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.

news.body: Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus said he remains in talks with multiple NFL teams.
news.head: Tyreek Hill remains in talks with multiple teams
news.impact: Hill continues to rehab his surgically repaired knee. Rosenhaus added that “nothing is imminent at this time.” He remains without a clear timetable to sign and return.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is expected to sign with a team in the coming days, per his agent. He’s been linked to the Chiefs, but other teams are in the mix.
news.head: Tyreek Hill expected to sign in the coming days
news.impact: Hill could give the Chiefs some depth, but it will be interesting to see how much of an impact he could make at this stage of his career while also coming off of a major knee injury. He’s worth stashing, but keep expectations low.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is not expected to sign with a team before the season begins, according to his agent Drew Rosenhaus.
news.head: Tyreek Hill not expected to sign before Week 1
news.impact: Hill has been on the long road to recovery after sustaining a major knee injury in Week 4 last season, and it looks like he will remain a free agent when the 2026 season begins. However, the 32-year-old could receive interest from contenders as the season goes on if he continues to progress in his rehab.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught six of his seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson catches TD in Week 8
news.impact: Robinson hauled in a 15-yard touchdown pass from Cam Ward in the fourth quarter to give the Titans a brief lead. The veteran wideout has caught 35 passes for 262 yards and three touchdowns through eight games. A solid WR4 in PPR fantasy leagues, he will be on his bye in Week 9.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught four of his six targets for seven yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson held to seven yards in Week 7
news.impact: Robinson was held to just 1.8 yards per carry by a tough Cleveland secondary. The veteran wideout has topped 50 receiving yards just twice in seven contests this season. Robinson will be a WR4 in fantasy heading into Week 8 against the Bengals.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson snags three passes in win
news.impact: Robinson and Carnell Tate were the only pass catchers to catch more than one pass from Cam Ward on Sunday, and also the only two to go over 10 yards. Robinson has had some usable performances this year, but they seem to come on an every-other-week basis.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson leads Titans in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Robinson posted his third game with 50 yards on the season. He remains a WR3/ flex play next week against the Colts.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson was able to contribute for the Texans on Sunday, scoring a touchdown on one of his three catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers should not have high hopes for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson hauled in one of the two touchdowns thrown by C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for 10 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson held to two receptions in Week 6
news.impact: Hutchinson logged his lowest receiving totals of the season in the win Sunday. With the addition of Marvin Harrison Jr. to the roster, Hutchinson's role will be limited and he should be left off fantasy rosters for now.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson totals team-high 65 yards Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson led Houston in receiving on the afternoon. He still remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he expects Xavier Worthy to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Reid added that Worthy was “feeling pretty good" as he battles a hamstring injury.

news.body: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Xavier Worthy is day-to-day.
news.head: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) considered day-to-day
news.impact: Worthy suffered a hamstring injury in Sunday's win over the Jets. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught all six of his targets for 48 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Xavier Worthy logs six receptions in Week 9 win
news.impact: Worthy led the Chiefs pass catchers in receptions Sunday, with Travis Kelce leading in yardage and Rashee Rice leading in targets. He did suffer a hamstring injury that saw him quickly ruled out by the team. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status ahead of a Week 10 matchup with the Falcons.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught three of six targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Xavier Worthy held to 13 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Worthy had six targets but averaged 4.3 yards per reception. He has 13 targets over his last two games, so opportunities aren't necessarily the problem. The production is. Worthy has 86 receiving yards over that stretch and remains a volatile fantasy option.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught three of six targets for 6 yards and ran three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Zay Flowers manages 23 yards in loss to Jags
news.impact: Flowers had three more catches than he had on Sunday, but it didn't amount to much. Jacoby Brissett should bring back some life to the fantasy value of Flowers once he takes the reins of the offense, and thankfully that should come next week.

news.body: Zay Flowers did not record a reception on five targets in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Zay Flowers held without a catch in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' receivers struggled with both Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) exiting the game with injuries. Jackson is expected to be placed on IR and Huntley's status is uncertain for Week 9. If Huntley is unable to play, Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' pass catchers should be downgraded in a matchup with Jacksonville.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Zay Flowers excellent in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Flowers opened the scoring on a 48-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Flowers led the team in all receiving categories, and he will look to do the same in Week 8 against the Bills.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers caught six passes for 66 yards on a season-high 11 targets in Week 6 against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers logs season-high 11 targets in Week 6
news.impact: Flowers' weekly floor has been impressive this season, recording at least 50 yards in every contest this season. It was his second game with double-digit targets in a concentrated passing attack that has been successful this season. When Lamar Jackson returns, Flowers has a higher ceiling, having failed to reach the end zone in the last two weeks.
